98f99b89.title: Presales Engineer
98f99b89.description:
**Designation: Presales Engineer** 




**Preferred Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Pune** 




  





**Job Summary :** 





 We are looking for a Presales Engineer with a strong technical background who can understand complex technical products and translate them into compelling solutions for clients. The role involves working closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to conduct product demos, handle technical discussions, and support deal closures.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  






 Technical Presales \& Solutioning\-
 





 ● Understand customer requirements and map them to appropriate technical solutions.
 





 ● Analyze client use cases and recommend product configurations or custom solutions.
 





 ● Act as the technical point of contact during the sales cycle.
 




  






 Product Demonstrations\-
 





 ● Conduct technical product demos, proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and walkthroughs for clients.
 





 ● Tailor demos based on customer industry, business challenges, and technical maturity.
 





 ●Clearly explain product architecture, features, and integrations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 




  






 Cross\-Functional \& Go\-To\-Market Support\-
 





 ● Partner with sales teams to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires.
 





 ● Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, and solution documentation.
 





 ● Support negotiations by addressing technical objections and concerns.
 





 ●Support cross\-functional initiatives beyond presales, including marketing, events, and solution positioning, as required.
 





 ●Collaborate with the marketing team to contribute to solution collateral, including flyers, brochures, case studies, and pitch decks.
 





 ●Assist in webinars, conferences, industry events, and product launches by supporting demos, presentations, and technical storytelling.
 





 ●Translate technical capabilities into clear, customer\-friendly messaging for digital and field marketing use cases.
 




  






 Stakeholder Collaboration\-
 





 ●Work closely with product and engineering teams to stay updated on new features and roadmap. ●Provide customer feedback to internal teams to improve product offerings. ●Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery/implementation teams. 
 




  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  






 Technical Skills \-
 





 ●Strong understanding of software products, SaaS platforms, or enterprise solutions.
 





 ●Strong ownership mindset with attention to detail and follow\-through.
 





 ●Comfort working with presentations, documentation, and visual storytelling for both technical and business audiences.
 





 ●Ability to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
 





 ●Hands\-on experience with demos, POCs, or solution presentations. ●Familiarity with cloud platforms, databases, or modern tech stacks is a plus. 
 




  






 Soft Skills \-
 





 ●Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 





 ●Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple, business\-friendly manner.
 





 ●Ability to work in cross\-functional roles spanning presales, marketing, and customer engagement when required.
 





 ●Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
 





 ●Confident in client\-facing interactions. 
 




  





**Experience :** 





 ●Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
 





 ●3 \- 6 years of experience in presales, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles. 
 




  





**Company Overview:** 





 Aventior is a leading provider of innovative, end\-to\-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting\-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps to build scalable, future\-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
 




  






 Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation \& ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics \& visualization, and automated data capture for unstructured and semi\-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.
 




  






 At Aventior, our strength lies in combining deep industry expertise with advanced technical capabilities. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision\-making.
 




  






 We bring a holistic, cross\-industry perspective to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support. With a global delivery model, a multi\-country presence, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well\-positioned to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes at scale.

6fdedf55.title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector | Splunk Security (Delhi/Gurgaon)
6fdedf55.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross\-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**
* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross\-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand\-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 7\+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4\+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1\+ year of related experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross\-sell, up\-sell, competitive displacement, or market\-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
   

  

**Disclaimer**
**About**
 To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
   

  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


 Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
   

  

 If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

**Company Description** 




 NEOS by Argon \& Co is the System Integration (SI) business arm of Argon \& Co, dedicated to delivering end\-to\-end digital transformation and technology\-enabled supply chain solutions.
 



 Building on Argon \& Co’s global supply chain expertise and Scott Sheldon’s more than two decades of experience across the US, UK, and India, NEOS combines strategic consulting with hands\-on technology implementation. We help organizations transform their supply chains through advanced planning, digital solutions, system integration, and operational readiness.
 



 NEOS works across industries including life sciences, high\-tech, consumer products, food \& beverage, industrial manufacturing, automotive, distribution, and metals. From strategy and technology selection to implementation, integration, and ongoing optimization, we enable clients to build agile, efficient, scalable, and future\-ready supply chains while delivering measurable and sustainable business impact.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a knowledgeable and client\-focused Solution Consultant with expertise in Kinaxis Maestro/Rapid Response to join our team. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and strong communication skills to deliver tailored solutions that address our clients' complex supply chain challenges. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Kinaxis and a proven ability to align technology capabilities with business objectives.

 • Serve as the subject matter expert for Kinaxis solutions during sales cycles and project delivery.
 



 • Support sales teams with technical expertise and thought leadership during the pre\-sales process.
 



 • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept scenarios.
 



 • Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and other documentation requests with detailed technical insights.
 



 • Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and vendors for solution delivery.
 



 • Maintain clear and regular communication with stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.
 



 • Provide post\-implementation guidance and training to ensure client success with Kinaxis solutions.
 



 • Collect feedback to refine processes and identify opportunities for future improvements.

1407638a.title: Senior Solution Engineer - GCC
1407638a.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 We are looking for world\-class Solution Architects to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilize the value of the cutting\-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 The Solution Architect will work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Architect will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof\-of\-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
   

  

***This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
 The Solution Architect has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

 How do you want to make your impact?

d66060b1.title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector | Splunk Security (Delhi/Gurgaon)
d66060b1.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross\-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**
* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross\-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand\-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 7\+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4\+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1\+ year of related experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross\-sell, up\-sell, competitive displacement, or market\-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
   

  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

 If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

 As a Customer Engineer (CE) for Google Cloud Security, you serve as the technical bridge between our most innovative security technologies and our customers' most complex business challenges. * Lead technical validations, including Proofs of Concept (PoC) and technical deep\-dives, proactively identify and remove roadblocks to ensure project success.

7785dd13.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**\#S\&SArchitect**
 \#CCaaS
   

  

**Customer**
 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level** 
 : Lead Business Transformation Architect
   

  

 As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 We are looking for a seasoned Five9 CCaaS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise\-grade cloud contact center solutions built on the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform. This is a senior technical role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, AI\-driven automation, and client advisory — equal parts strategist and builder.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on Five9 expertise, a strong grasp of modern CCaaS architecture patterns, and the communication fluency to translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for clients and stakeholders.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead end\-to\-end CCaaS solution design — from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and rollout. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performing Five9 architectures that align with client goals and industry best practices.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as the primary technical authority across multiple concurrent client engagements. Conduct solution and code reviews, establish architecture governance standards, and maintain quality assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Five9 Platform Configuration \& Deployment: Design and configure the full breadth of Five9 capabilities including VCC Core, ACD/IVR/IVA (Intelligent Virtual Agent) with complex call flows, outbound campaigns and predictive dialing logic, Workforce Automation (WFA), Quality Management (QM/WEM), digital channels, and AI\-driven features such as Five9 Genius AI.
* Integration \& Connectivity Architecture: Architect and implement enterprise\-grade integrations with CRM and ITSM platforms — including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and Zendesk — using Five9's pre\-built adapters and the Agent Desktop Toolkit Plus (ADT\+). 7 8 Design and implement REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and advanced scripting. Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.
* AI \& Automation Strategy: Drive the adoption of Five9's Genius AI capabilities — including Intelligent Voice Assistants, AI\-powered Agent Assist, the AI Summary Node, Knowledge Node (RAG\-based), and the AI Trust \& Governance framework. Provide architectural guidance on deploying responsible, hallucination\-aware AI within the contact center environment. 9 10 Stay ahead of Five9's evolving Agentic CX roadmap and help clients position for next\-generation capabilities.
* Performance Optimization \& Reporting: Configure dashboards, real\-time reporting, and supervisor tools to monitor and continuously optimize contact center operations. Guide clients on best practices for scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application, platform, network, cloud, and telecom layers. Drive rapid resolution with minimal disruption to customer\-facing operations.
* Collaboration, Scoping \& Delivery: Partner with project managers for accurate effort estimation, scoping, risk management, and on\-time delivery. Lead and mentor engineers, consultants, and junior delivery team members to elevate technical capability and solution quality across the team.
* Client Engagement \& Presentations: Deliver compelling client\-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and value propositions. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.


**The team:**
 Our Sales \& Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user\-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data\-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on architecture experience with the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform, including VCC, IVR/IVA, WFA, QM/WEM, and digital channels
* Advanced understanding of CCaaS architecture patterns, enterprise scalability design, and cloud contact center infrastructure
* Solid understanding of core contact center operations: ACD, IVR, CTI, and CRM integration workflows
* Experience migrating legacy on\-premise contact centers to Five9 cloud environments
* Proficiency in enterprise integration design using REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and scripting languages (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
* Strong command of authentication protocols: SSO, SAML, OAuth
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CX — chatbots, virtual agents, predictive analytics, agent assist, and GenAI\-driven capabilities
* Awareness of compliance and security frameworks relevant to CCaaS: PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR
* Bonus: Server\-side development experience in Node.js, Java, PHP, or .NET
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to present confidently to executive and technical audiences
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop delivery teams
* Strong client advisory mindset — able to frame technical decisions in terms of business outcomes


**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
* Five9 Certifications: Five9 Certified Administrator, Five9 Certified Implementor, or Global Partner Certified Implementation Partner credentials are highly desirable
* AI/GenAI Certifications: A plus, given the growing centrality of Genius AI and agentic workflows in Five9 deployments


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

The purpose of this role is to create solution architectures for systems and platforms ensuring all relevant options are explored for time, cost and compliance to the company’s standards, policies and practices whilst meeting the business’ requirements. The role will oversee the work of other architects and delivery of the solution for clients both internal and external, shepherding it through the relevant governance.

This role combines technical architecture, hands\-on development, and direct client engagement to build scalable, secure integration solutions across banking, telecom, automotive, healthcare and aviation sectors. The ideal candidate will drive end\-to\-end solutioning from requirements gathering through implementation and serve as a trusted advisor to global clients on platform customization, data flow automation, and cloud\-native transformation.

b05f308c.title: SAP Order Management Solution Architect
b05f308c.description:
**Role:** 
**SAP Order Management Solution Architect**
 Location: Pune (Hybrid)
   

  

**Life Unlimited.** 
 At Smith\+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.
   

  

 Smith \& Nephew (S\+N) is a large multinational Medical Technology organization with an extensive Enterprise Applications ecosystem to run end\-to\-end business operations. ERPs form the core of this ecosystem and are tightly integrated with best\-in\-class systems such as Salesforce, Windchill, Movemedical, Maestro, Ariba, Workday and many more. At S\+N, SAP serves as our primary and strategic ERP platform, running 80% of our operations and revenue.
   

  

 We are seeking an SAP Order Management Solution Architect to design and deliver SAP solutions and customizations aligned with business requirements, while supporting and preparing for our strategic transition to SAP S/4HANA. Therefore, this role is both strategic and pivotal, playing a key part in enabling Smith \& Nephew's digital transformation and continued growth over the coming years.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
* The Order Management Solution Architect is responsible for partnering with Business Process Owners to design and deliver Order to Cash solutions that meet business needs.
* This role requires strong SAP OM/SD expertise, a solid understanding of complex multinational business processes, and experience delivering large\-scale global SAP implementations.
* The ideal candidate combines strong solution architecture capabilities with the ability to drive business value through standardized, scalable, and efficient processes.
* Define enterprise integration architecture aligned with SAP roadmap (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP BTP etc.).
* Collaborate with business, functional, and technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into integration architecture designs.
* Lead system integration architecture across SAP and third\-party applications.
* Design end\-to\-end integration solutions using: SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration) SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Open Connectors).
* Ensure integration scalability, high availability, and performance optimization.
* Implement security protocols (OAuth, SAML, certificates, encryption).
* Provide guidance during implementation and production support.
* Troubleshoot complex integration issues and Lead root\-cause analysis and performance tuning.
* Participates in SAP related projects (releases and/or rollouts) and conducts requirement gathering, fit/gap analysis, design and build activities.
* Focus on continuous improvement, keeping up with industry and proactively advising the business of new capabilities that can help them support the company’s growth and strategy.


**What will you need to be successful?**
* Education: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, IT or related subject preferred.
* Licenses/ Certifications:
* SAP certification: SAP Certified Development / Integration certifications (SAP CPI, BTP etc.)
* TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification
* ITIL Qualifications
* Experience: At least 10 years of IT experience, with 8\+ years in SAP architecture.
* This role will be based in Pune, Hybrid\- work model, 2 days working from office.
* Lead the design, delivery, and governance of SAP solutions across global releases, rollouts, and transformation programs.
* Provide expert L3 support for Live countries and ensure stability, reliability, and optimal performance of business\-critical SAP applications.
* Govern solution changes through Design Authority processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, global standards, and long\-term strategic objectives.
* Champion continuous improvement and innovation by leveraging emerging SAP capabilities and industry best practices to enable business growth and transformation.
* Hands\-on experience with S/4HANA transformation programs and Experience in cloud integration and API\-led architecture is advantageous.
* Experience in a full cycle of an ERP implementation based on a core solution and multi\-country deployment.
* Experience in information systems, applications \- including SAP (SD, MM, WM, PP, and FI/CO), and project management, preferably in regulated life science industry.
* Functional knowledge within functional area of SAP ECC6 EHP\-7 (or later) is a must, experience of HANA preferred. Experience in SAP BASIS/ABAP would be a plus.
* Working experience in other MWs (BOOMI/SOA etc.) would be a plus. Experience in a regulated industry and/or medical device company preferred. Large transformational projects.
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management capabilities. Solid functional and technical expertise in SAP business processes and operating models.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Collaborative, team\-oriented mindset. Detail\-oriented, well\-organized, and able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
* Understanding of software development standards, processes, and QA practices.


**You. Unlimited.**
**We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.**
**Inclusion \+ Belonging \- Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving. Learn more about our Employee Inclusion Groups on our website** 
**https://www.smith\-nephew.com/**
**Other reasons why you will love it here!**
* Your Future: Major Medical coverage \+ Policy exclusions and insurance non\-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
* Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
* Your Wellbeing: Parents / Parents in Law’s Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
* Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
* Training: Hands\-On, Team\-Customized, Mentorship
* Extra Perks: Free Cab Transport facility for all employees, One Time Meal provided to all employees as per shift. Night Shift Allowances.


 Stay connected by joining our Talent Community.
   

  

 We're more than just a company \- we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.
   

  

 Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into
 **You. Unlimited.** 
 , life, culture, and benefits at S\+N.
   

  

 Explore our website and learn more about our mission, our team, and the opportunities we offer.

 Windows/Linux server administration, VMware, storage and network services, SQL Server

 AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, compute, storage,
* networking, landing zones, and migration tooling.
  


* **DevOps \& SRE:** 
 Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions),

* **Security \& resilience:**

* compliance management.
* **Service management:**

Its unique model of state\-of\-the\-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands\-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 300,000 individuals across 80\+ countries.

The role requires someone with a strong background in delivery of learning journeys, comfort interacting with faculty and clients, and managing technology platforms.

f1e0ad87.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high\-stakes, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end\-to\-end program delivery plans for multi\-team initiatives, translating high\-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.
* Architecture \& Dependency Management: Identify, track, and resolve complex cross\-functional dependencies across API contracts, core platform services, and external integrations.
* Technical Problem Solving: Drive alignment on system trade\-offs (e.g., latency, scalability, technical debt) and participate in architectural reviews to keep execution aligned with long\-term platform health.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical, security, and operational risks weeks before they impact launch schedules, building actionable contingency plans.
* Operational Excellence: Establish a lightweight, high\-impact execution cadence (e.g., agile delivery processes, integration testing syncs, execution metrics, post\-mortems) across distributed engineering teams.
* Executive Communication: Synthesize technical status, risks, and execution health into clear, data\-driven updates for senior leadership.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Experience: 7\+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service\-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
* Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large\-scale, multi\-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
* Leadership \& Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.
* Data\-Driven: Proficiency with program management frameworks (Jira, Confluence) and using metrics to measure delivery velocity and system reliability.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in ad tech, data engineering, complex integrations (e.g., third\-party verification, SDK integrations), or high\-throughput real\-time systems.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With:**
 Arista is seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager. This is a critical role, ensuring that Arista customer driven programs complete milestone deliverables to meet the customer’s needs and prevent delays to their internal development and deployment programs. As a Technical Program Manager you will work directly with experienced internal cross\-disciplinary engineering team leaders, customers, and strategic partners to drive hardware product development from planning, design, validation, qualification, through release to volume production. You will lead the cross\-functional engineering team through the NPI product lifecycle phases and the associated design and phase gate reviews. Strong leadership, communications, problem solving, and communication skills are essential.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Specific Duties and Responsibilities:
   

  

* Creating statement of work (SoW) and product requirement documents (PRD) for complex technical programs
* Owns and facilitates weekly cross\-functional engineering team meetings.
* Interface with key customers and strategic partners to develop program plans including negotiating schedules, milestone deliverables, prototype allocations, and feature set.
* Lead a cross\-functional team from HW, SW, Central, and Diagnostic engineering, manufacturing engineering, product management, ODM/JDM partners, and customer support to deliver outstanding products to the market.
* You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on the cross\-functional design engineering validation, and qualification status of your programs, as well as identifying and solving any concerns prior to them causing impact.
* Create a master schedule that captures and inter\-connects the key cross\-functional deliverables as defined by the product development lifecycle and ensure the team stays on track to meet program milestones.
* Lead program design review and bug scrub meetings
* Identify risks on program planning and actively work on mitigation plan with all stake holders
* Drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, and milestone checkpoint reviews.
* Drive cross\-functional issue resolution ensuring issues are identified, assigned owners, and tracked to closure. Ensure issues are escalated to the appropriate functional leaders.
* Facilitate engineering portion of phase gate review meetings


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of NPI hardware engineering and leadership experience
* Design engineering, New Product Introduction, and manufacturing experience with rack\-mounted data center or enterprise equipment
* Experience working with multiple engineering disciplines including electrical, mechanical, software, diagnostics, test, and manufacturing engineering team members
* Exceptional project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills.
* Significant working knowledge of hardware development.
* Proven track record of managing hardware projects and delivering on time.
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative, define, document, implement new processes.
* Experience interfacing with product management, internal cross\-functional engineering teams, and sub\-tier suppliers
* Ability to listen and simplify complex topics for non\-technical audiences, and prepare summaries for executives and stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electronics and communication, industrial engineering or equivalent experience. MS/MBA and PMP are desirable.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

Job Description: Technical Program Manager (Hackathons \& Innovation Challenges)
 



 Position: Program Manager
 



 Location: Noida, UP, India (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**The role** 




 You are the single point of ownership for every program you run — end to end, from pre\-launch kickoff to the final debrief. Not the coordinator of it: the owner. Scope, the client relationship, and the final call all sit with you.
 



 What makes this role different from a conventional program management role is where the ownership comes from.
 



 You will be the trusted partner for our clients and the central hub for all internal teams, ensuring that every hackathon is delivered flawlessly, on time, and within budget. This role is for a natural leader who thrives on structure, excels at communication, and has a passion for turning ambitious ideas into reality.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Technical program design. Problem statements, evaluation criteria, judging rubrics, and tech\-stack fit. You decide what a good submission looks like and defend that standard to clients and juries.
* End\-to\-end program ownership. Multiple concurrent programs from post\-sales handover through delivery and debrief. Scope, objectives, timelines, and resourcing are yours to define.
* The client relationship, post\-sales. Primary point of contact once sales hands over. You set expectations, manage change, and are the voice on technical scope and feasibility — including on what isn’t deliverable.
* Strategic program architecture. You build the blueprint. Defining objectives, resource allocation, and timelines is your domain. You ensure every component is technically sound and logistically viable before a single line of code is written.
* Internal cross\-functional bridge. You lead the charge across Marketing, Operations, and SME teams. You are the glue that keeps diverse internal stakeholders aligned and focused on delivering a cohesive product.
* Risk and quality gatekeeping. Spotting friction before it happens. You own the mitigation strategies and maintain a relentless standard for the participant experience and final deliverables.
* Scope and fiscal discipline. You hold the line on the budget and the agreed\-upon roadmap. Using rigorous verification, you ensure we deliver exactly what was promised without slippage.
* External partner synchronization. Managing the ecosystem. You direct third\-party vendors and partners to ensure their contributions integrate seamlessly into the live event execution.
* Documentation and executive reporting. Maintaining the narrative of progress. You provide clear, direct visibility on milestones and technical hurdles to both clients and our leadership team.
* Jury and participant experience. Recruiting and briefing evaluators, running the judging process with rigour, and making sure the experience holds up for developers and students who chose to spend a weekend on it.



  





**What you'll need** 



* Deep technical fluency. You can hold an architecture\-level conversation with a client, a jury, or a partner without escalating it. You can read a submission and judge whether it actually works. Hands\-on coding is not required — credible technical judgement is non\-negotiable.
* Experience. 4–7 years in program or project management in a technical environment — technical program management, developer relations, solutions or pre\-sales engineering, or an engineer who moved into program work. Enterprise clients somewhere in that history.
* Domain expertise. Working knowledge of the domains we run challenges in — AI/ML, cloud, and data at minimum. Enough to tell an ambitious problem statement from an unworkable one.
* Enterprise client\-facing strength. Polished, direct, and comfortable holding a line on scope with a senior stakeholder who wants more than was agreed.
* Organisational discipline. Several programs running at once, each with its own client, timeline, and jury. Detail matters and slippage is visible.
* Developer and student community instinct. You understand what makes a hackathon worth entering, and what makes participants disengage.

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer
53bf8952.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise\-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client\-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands\-on technical execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI\-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI\-generated or AI\-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C\+\+, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post\-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best\-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer\-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C\+\+, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third\-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise\-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

 What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
   

  

* Remote \& In\-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
* Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet\-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
* Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in\-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9\-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
* Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no\-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls \& company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
* Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

0f3fb83f.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Business Data Technologies
0f3fb83f.description:
**Description**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Data Access Controls team in Business Data Technologies (BDT). You will own and drive complex programs that define how Amazon's largest data lake is governed, ensuring the right people see the right data at the right time.
   

  

 You will partner with AWS teams, Amazon security and compliance organizations, and multiple engineering teams to deliver governance solutions used by hundreds of thousands of data consumers. You will drive large outcomes by influencing across organizational boundaries, creating structure in ambiguous spaces, and shipping programs that balance security with usability.
   

  

 This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in technical architecture discussions and stakeholder alignment meetings. You will need to understand distributed systems, data access control models, and policy frameworks well enough to challenge designs, identify risks early, and make trade\-offs that protect customer trust without creating unnecessary friction.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own complex, multi\-quarter programs end\-to\-end, from requirements through delivery to adoption, spanning engineering, product, UX, and compliance teams
* Drive cross\-organizational alignment with policy steward organizations (Privacy, InfoSec, Legal) to rationalize, design, and onboard new compliance policies into the access control system
* Run large\-scale adoption campaigns coordinating hundreds of dataset owner teams to classify data and enable governance controls
* Partner with AWS service teams to design solutions that work within and extend their capabilities
* Define and track program metrics and drive measurable improvements
* Identify technical risks in system designs and ensure current implementations do not block future architectural evolution
* Create clarity and structure in high\-ambiguity domains where governance requirements, technical constraints, and customer experience must be balanced simultaneously
* Influence engineering architecture decisions and drive technical trade\-offs across teams without direct authority
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions effectively to senior leadership


 A day in the life
   

  

 We own the fine\-grained access control system that governs every analytical query across Amazon's data lake: policy definition, access requests, approval workflows, permission enforcement, and renewal. We're building toward self\-service governance where data owners control their own access policies without bottlenecks, and pioneering access controls for AI and multi\-modal data (images, video, audio, ML artifacts), a space with no industry playbook.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Compelling**
 High ambiguity: we're defining new governance primitives, not just implementing specs
   

  

 Every improvement directly impacts hundreds of thousands of data consumers or strengthens Amazon's security posture
   

  

 Cross\-cutting influence: you'll partner with Privacy, InfoSec, Legal, and every SDO data team
   

  

 The problems are genuinely hard: balancing security with usability, scaling fine\-grained controls without drowning consumers in friction, designing abstractions that hold across column\-based, row\-based, and identity\-resolved policies
   

  

 You'll shape the roadmap, not just execute it
   

  

**About The Team**
 We own the fine\-grained access control system that governs every analytical query across Amazon's data lake: policy definition, access requests, approval workflows, permission enforcement, and renewal. We're building toward self\-service governance where data owners control their own access policies without bottlenecks, and pioneering access controls for AI and multi\-modal data (images, video, audio, ML artifacts), a space with no industry playbook.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

8b4d59a9.description:
**About The Team**
 At Zillow, our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate team powers the advertising experiences that connect brands and service providers to hundreds of millions of Zillow visitors each month.
   

  

 We operate at the intersection of consumer experience, marketplace dynamics, and revenue generation. Whether it’s scaling ad delivery platforms across search and home detail pages, integrating on\-site and off\-site media, or enabling experimentation and measurement at scale, Elevate plays a critical role in Zillow’s growth strategy.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact team where programs directly influence revenue, customer experience, and advertiser value.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery and ongoing success of technical advertising solutions. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Ad Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to turn defined goals into clear plans and coordinate programs from planning through launch.
   

  

 You will bring structure to complex work, maintain alignment across stakeholders, and help teams identify and address risks, dependencies, and decisions. You will use established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute.
   

  

 The role focuses three primary areas:
   

  

* Program \& Platform Delivery Delivery: Lead the end\-to\-end execution of defined, cross\-functional technical programs. Translate product and technical requirements into clear, dependency\-aware plans; coordinate milestones and delivery activities; and proactively surface risks, decisions, and tradeoffs. Apply established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan and execute.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner with stakeholders across consumer\-facing teams, revenue teams, and shared technical platforms to deliver cohesive advertising experiences. Build shared understanding of scope, priorities, responsibilities, and delivery expectations. Facilitate timely decisions and help teams navigate competing needs and dependencies.
* Operational Excellence \& Experimentation: Support reliable, measurable, and continuously improving program execution. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to coordinate experiment readiness, performance monitoring, release planning, and incident follow\-up. Use program and operational insights to identify execution gaps and recommend improvements.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You are an organized and collaborative program leader who brings clarity and structure to complex technical work. You are comfortable leading programs with defined goals, managing dependencies across teams, and adapting plans as new information emerges.
   

  

 You combine disciplined execution with a continuous improvement mindset. You are comfortable working within established practices while recommending thoughtful improvements that reduce friction and help teams deliver effectively.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience managing technical programs or complex cross\-functional projects in agile environments
* Experience leading technical initiatives from planning through delivery
* Experience coordinating work across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, or other cross\-functional partners
* Strong program management skills, including planning, risk management, dependency tracking, release readiness, and stakeholder communication
* Ability to organize and synthesize complex information into clear plans, decisions, and updates
* Ability to understand technical concepts, system dependencies, and their connection to customer or business outcomes
* Experience identifying and implementing continuous improvements to program delivery processes, frameworks, and operating practices to strengthen execution
* Demonstrated ability to build alignment and influence outcomes without direct authority
* Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non\-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting experimentation, measurement, or data\-informed product development
* Experience working with advertising, media, or marketplace platforms, such as Google Ad Manager, Prebid, supply\-side platforms, demand\-side platforms, data management platforms, or programmatic infrastructure


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

Solutions may support government, border management, immigration, customs, or national security customers operating in mission\-critical environments.

Including ownership of technical risk, compliance, and feasibility for large\-scale government and border programs.
