7cba452e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Now
7cba452e.description:
**Description**
 We build the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses, the platform that powers shopping journeys across marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive platform programs spanning 12\+ tenants and 500\+ developers as we evolve from a multi marketplace stack into a true multi business platform.
   

  

 You will own the programs that turn a single business stack into versioned API contracts, a federated front end, and surface agnostic shopping capabilities that any Amazon business can configure into a journey of its own shape. Each tenant brings different needs, and your job is to sequence that work so businesses compose journeys instead of forking the platform.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical programs and many stakeholder coordination, who can hold a three year architectural direction while shipping quarter over quarter, and who cares that a page is ready in sub\-second at Amazon volume.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own cross team programs that deliver certified, versioned API contracts and a bring your own API extension path, so new businesses onboard by configuration rather than by forking the stack.
* Drive the front end federation program (shell, component registry, tenant packages, build time isolation) across feature teams shipping independently to production.
* Coordinate onboarding of new tenants and marketplaces, cutting time to launch from three months toward weeks, and track the platform effort each onboarding costs.
* Run the performance, resilience, and observability programs that keep every journey fast and tenant isolated at scale, including interaction budgets, alarm based rollback, and prevention of cross tenant incidents.
* Build the mechanisms that govern what earns a place in the shared core versus what stays a business owned extension, resolving competing tenant needs across 12\+ clients.
* Manage dependencies with partner platforms and drive convergence decisions.
* Establish program rhythm across 500\+ developers: roadmaps, release schedules, risk and critical path management, and quarterly checkpoints against annual targets.
* Translate a three year platform vision into sequenced, committed deliverables with clear exit criteria.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start with the programs in flight across the platform, unblocking a tenant onboarding here and a contract certification there. You work with multiple senior and principal engineers on architecture tradeoffs, with product managers on which capabilities graduate into the core, and with partner teams on shared dependencies. You keep the performance and resilience bars visible, chase down a latency regression before it crosses tenants, and prep the quarterly checkpoint against annual targets. Your stakeholders span multiple leaders from fast growing businesses WW, and your customers are the Amazon teams building shopping experience using our platform.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We currently run the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses. What began as one team's customer journey stack has grown into a single platform serving multiple marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are a B2B product whose customers are Amazon businesses, and our mission is to let any of them launch, experiment, and scale a shopping journey without building the stack beneath it. Multiple Amazon businesses came to us organically because the paradigm works. We are now one architectural shape away from becoming the default place a new shopping journey starts at Amazon, and this role helps get us there.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience owning program strategy for a platform, set of APIs, or shared services consumed by multiple internal teams
* Experience delivering versioned API contracts, developer facing tooling, or tenant onboarding programs at scale
* Experience driving performance, resilience, or observability programs across distributed systems
* Experience developing and executing technical roadmaps across many stakeholder teams


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including hyperscale computing, automotive, 5G communications, aerospace, industrial, consumer and health.

* The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.

 You will have an opportunity to acquire both breadth and depth of technical knowledge, get wide exposure to latest hardware and software architectures that customers are working on, and keep pace with the latest developments in model\-based systems engineering/hybrid prototyping.
   

  

 As first\-hand users of Cadence Virtual and Hybrid tooling, combined with deeper understanding of customer expectations, you shall have the opportunity to provide invaluable feedback to product teams to continuously improve the underlying tools and technologies.
   

  

 This an excellent opportunity to work in a supportive and friendly work environment, where we are vested in each other’s success, and we are passionate about technology, learning and innovation.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Understand customer software and system validation requirements to assess specific modelling needs.
* Create, optimize and validate system models using C/C\+\+/SystemC.
* Integrate and validate models/platforms into bigger hierarchies.
* Bring\-up production SW stacks on Virtual/Hybrid platforms.
* Help customers debug SW bring\-up and system validation issues.
* Help build custom flows between third party tools and Cadence Virtual/Hybrid tooling.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BTech/ME/MS/MTech in Computer Science/Electrical/Electronics


**Experience And Technical Skills**
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in Virtual/Hybrid Prototyping.
* Sound knowledge of C/C\+\+/SystemC/scripting languages.
* Sound understanding of computer architecture and embedded SW stacks.
* Skills around integrating flows involving debug and simulation tools is desired.
* Must have excellent debugging skills with ability to understand HW/SW interactions.


 Behavioral skills
   

  

* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Good customer facing inter\-personal skills.
* Leadership qualities to drive growth and innovation.
* Work effectively across functions and geographies.
* Push to raise the bar while always operating with integrity


**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

+ Spring Boot
+ Spring Batch
+ Spring Cloud
+ Microservices Architecture
+ API Design \& Integration

* Extensive experience migrating applications from:
+ Monolithic to Microservices
+ On\-Premises to Azure

* Deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture and platform services.
* Hands\-on expertise with Terraform (Mandatory) and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Strong experience with:
+ Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
+ Kubernetes (AKS preferred) and Docker
+ CI/CD Architecture
+ DevSecOps

* Experience with:
+ Event\-driven architectures
+ Kafka / Event Hub
+ Service Bus
+ CDC and Data Synchronization

bbd1d159.description:

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Name\-GDS Consulting Cloud Data Architect – Databricks**
**Position Summary**
 The Cloud Data Architect will lead the strategic migration and transformation of enterprise data platforms from legacy systems to modern cloud\-native architectures using Databricks. This role is pivotal in enabling scalable, secure, and high\-performance data analytics environments for EY clients across sectors.
   

  

 The architect will be responsible for designing future\-state reference architectures, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with EY’s data modernization strategy. The role demands deep technical expertise, hands\-on leadership, and the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology domains.
   

  

 The leader will be responsible for accelerating the following:
   

  

 Strategic Leadership
   

  

* Drive the strategic vision for cloud data modernization, leveraging Databricks capabilities within EY
* Lead cross\-functional teams across geographies to deliver scalable data solutions that support enterprise transformation.
* Influence client C\-suite stakeholders by articulating the business value of cloud\-native data architectures. Market Intelligence and Go\-To\-Market (GTM)
* Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies in cloud data platforms to inform solution strategy.
* Collaborate with EY GTM teams to develop differentiated offerings around Databricks.
* Contribute to EY’s market positioning by aligning architecture capabilities with client demand and sector\-specific needs.


 Sales and Business Development
   

  

* Support pre\-sales activities including client workshops, RFP responses, and solution demos.
* Partner with account teams to identify opportunities for cloud data transformation and drive pipeline growth.
* Translate client requirements into scalable architecture proposals that align with EY’s delivery capabilities.


 Thought Leadership
   

  

* Represent EY in industry forums, webinars, and conferences focused on cloud data and analytics.
* Author whitepapers, blogs, and internal knowledge assets on Databricks best practices.
* Mentor junior architects and contribute to EY’s internal capability development programs.


 Partnership and Ecosystem Development
   

  

* Build and nurture strategic alliances with Databricks and Azure to codevelop joint solutions.
* Engage with technology partners to stay abreast of product roadmaps and integration capabilities.
* Leverage EY’s ecosystem to deliver end\-to\-end solutions that span data, AI, cloud, and security.


**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Lead and architect the migration of data analytics environments from legacy systems to Databricks with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Define high\-level migration roadmaps and future\-state reference architectures on Azure cloud.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end data analytics solutions leveraging Databricks utilities and big data modeling techniques using Python.
* Setup, configure, and deploy Databricks solutions across multidepartment environments.
* Guide teams in implementing best practices for data transformation, aggregation, and workload management.
* Address technical inquiries related to customization, integration, and enterprise architecture.
* Enable business stakeholders to make data\-driven decisions through accurate analysis, reporting, and presentation of key findings.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**
* Make strategic decisions on cloud architecture design, resource allocation, and technology investments.
* Evaluate performance metrics and ROI of Databricks implementations.
* Conduct impact analysis of proposed solutions on client operations, including cost\-benefit, scalability, and integration feasibility.
* Prioritize solution components based on business value and technical feasibility.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 15\-20 years of experience in data architecture, solution design, and implementation.
* At least two end\-to\-end implementations of Databricks and cloud data platforms.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale data migration projects and managing cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in client\-facing roles with a track record of delivering high\-impact solutions.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Proven experience in designing and implementing cloud data warehouse solutions (Databricks) on Azure.
* Deep understanding of Databricks architecture including compute/storage separation, RBAC, performance tuning, and advanced features like time travel and zero\-copy clone.
* Expertise in big data modeling, ETL pipeline optimization, and Python\-based data engineering.
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to manage client relationships and drive consensus.
* Experience in handling complex deployments and multi\-tower configurations.
* Familiarity with Presto/Starburst, shell scripting, and Unix/Windows environments is a plus.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**ITSM Solutions Architect** 




 Department: Information Technology
 



 Location: Kondapur, Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Mode: Work From Office – 5 Days a Week
 



 Shift Timings: 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent
 



 Reports To: IT Operations Manager / Director of IT Infrastructure \& Operations
 



**Position Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced ITSM Solutions Architect – Service Desk Plus Enterprise with 8\+ years of experience in IT Service Management, ITSM platforms, service desk operations, and enterprise ITSM solution design.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Service Desk Plus Enterprise or comparable enterprise ITSM platforms, with proven experience designing and implementing scalable ITSM solutions, optimizing ITIL processes, configuring workflows and automation, integrating enterprise applications, and driving continuous service improvement.
 



 This role will serve as a technical and process architect, working closely with IT Operations, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable ITSM solutions aligned with organizational objectives, ITIL best practices, governance, compliance, and operational standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* ITSM Solution Architecture \& Design
* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale ITSM solutions using Service Desk Plus Enterprise or similar ITSM platforms.
* Define scalable, sustainable, and standardized ITSM platform architecture aligned with business and operational requirements.
* Conduct process reviews, discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and stakeholder consultations to identify service management needs.
* Translate business and technical requirements into effective ITSM processes, workflows, service models, and platform solutions.
* Develop solution designs, workflow diagrams, process documentation, and technical specifications.
* Establish platform standards, configuration guidelines, governance processes, and best practices.
* Lead process reviews and stakeholder governance meetings to evaluate service performance, process effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.



**Service Desk Plus Enterprise Configuration** 



* Configure, administer, and maintain Service Desk Plus Enterprise modules, including:
* Incident Management
* Request Management
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Asset Management
* Service Catalog
* CMDB
* Design and optimize request templates, categories, forms, business rules, approval processes, user roles, escalation paths, notifications, and SLAs.
* Configure service workflows and automation rules to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Design and maintain Service Catalog structures and self\-service capabilities.
* Ensure platform configurations are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with organizational standards.



**Workflow Automation \& Orchestration** 



* Design and implement workflow automation, orchestration, and self\-service capabilities across ITSM processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive service desk and IT operations activities.
* Develop automated approval, assignment, escalation, notification, and fulfillment workflows.
* Evaluate and implement automation capabilities that improve ticket resolution, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Support integration of AI\-enabled service management features, chatbots, virtual assistants, and predictive analytics where applicable.
* Continuously evaluate emerging ITSM automation capabilities and recommend improvements.



**ITIL Process Management** 



* Design, implement, and optimize ITIL\-aligned processes covering:
* Incident Management
* Request Fulfillment
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Asset Management
* Configuration Management
* Service Level Management


- 


**Enterprise Integrations \& API Architecture** 



* Design and support enterprise application integrations between the ITSM platform and other business and technology systems.
* Define API and automation design strategies for integrating Service Desk Plus with enterprise applications.
* Work with REST APIs, web services, and other integration technologies as applicable.
* Support integrations with systems such as HRIS, ERP, identity platforms, monitoring tools, endpoint management platforms, collaboration tools, and other enterprise applications.
* Define integration requirements, data flows, authentication methods, error handling, and monitoring processes.
* Ensure integrations are secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable.



**CMDB \& Configuration Management** 



* Define and maintain Configuration Management Database (CMDB) concepts, standards, and governance.
* Support identification and management of Configuration Items (CIs), relationships, dependencies, and ownership.
* Establish processes for maintaining accurate and reliable configuration data.
* Integrate CMDB information with Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and other ITSM processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve configuration data quality and visibility across the enterprise.



**Reporting, Analytics \& Performance Management** 



* Analyze ITSM data and develop reports, dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and service performance metrics.
* Monitor SLA compliance, ticket volumes, backlog health, resolution trends, recurring incidents, and service performance.
* Provide data\-driven insights to IT leadership and stakeholders.
* Identify trends and process bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
* Support predictive analytics and AI\-enabled reporting capabilities where applicable.



**Governance, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Establish and maintain ITSM platform governance, configuration standards, and compliance controls.
* Ensure ITSM processes align with organizational policies, ITIL best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support audits by maintaining accurate ITSM records, process documentation, configuration documentation, and governance evidence.
* Identify opportunities for ITSM transformation and continuous improvement.
* Develop roadmaps for platform enhancements, automation, integrations, and process maturity.
* Evaluate existing processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, user experience, service quality, and operational control.



**Implementation, Testing \& Production Support** 




**Lead ITSM platform enhancement initiatives through the complete lifecycle:** 



* Requirements Gathering
* Process Analysis
* Solution Design
* Configuration
* Development
* Testing
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Deployment
* Production Support
* Continuous Optimization
* Develop test plans and validate configuration changes before production deployment.
* Coordinate release and change activities with relevant technical teams.
* Troubleshoot complex platform, workflow, integration, and configuration issues.
* Provide technical guidance and support for production incidents related to the ITSM platform.



**Stakeholder Management \& Consulting** 



* Collaborate with Service Desk, IT Operations, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver effective ITSM solutions.
* Lead stakeholder workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions.
* Provide consulting and recommendations on ITSM process design, platform capabilities, automation, and governance.
* Communicate complex technical and process concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Lead stakeholder governance meetings and provide updates on platform performance, initiatives, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Work independently while managing multiple priorities and cross\-functional initiatives.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT Service Management, Service Desk Operations, IT Operations, ITSM platform administration, or ITSM solution architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Service Desk Plus Enterprise or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale ITSM solutions.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher – Mandatory.
* Strong experience with ITSM workflow configuration, automation, SLA management, reporting, and dashboards.
* Experience with enterprise application integrations, API design, automation, Service Catalog, and CMDB concepts.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and process optimization skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder management and consulting abilities.
* Advanced ITIL certification.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working in healthcare, government, financial services, or other regulated environments.
* Experience with Service Desk Plus Enterprise architecture and large\-scale implementations.
* Experience with ITSM transformation and service management maturity initiatives.
* Experience implementing workflow automation, orchestration, and self\-service solutions.
* Knowledge of AI\-enabled ITSM, chatbot/virtual\-agent integrations, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.



**Key Competencies** 



* ITSM Solutions Architecture
* Enterprise ITSM Platform Architecture
* Service Desk Plus Enterprise
* ITIL Process Management
* Incident, Request, Change \& Problem Management
* ITSM Process Analysis \& Optimization
* Workflow \& Automation Configuration
* Workflow Automation \& Orchestration
* Service Catalog Design
* Configuration Management \& CMDB
* Asset Management
* SLA \& Service Performance Management
* Reporting, Dashboards \& Data Analytics
* Enterprise Application Integrations
* API \& Automation Design
* ITSM Transformation \& Continuous Improvement
* Platform Governance \& Compliance
* Solution Design \& Technical Documentation
* Stakeholder Consulting \& Requirements Gathering
* Process Reviews \& Governance
* Excellent Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

The role combines large\-scale programme delivery, Agile product management, executive stakeholder engagement and data storytelling. You will work closely with the CISO and senior leadership to shape the solution, manage delivery and coordinate a multidisciplinary team across research, quantitative analysis, data engineering and Power BI.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Programme \& Delivery Leadership
 



 • Own delivery of a complex, multi\-year enterprise analytics programme.
 



 • Lead governance, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, quality and stakeholder management.
 



 • Run the programme using Agile methodologies, including backlog management, prioritisation, sprint planning, user stories and acceptance criteria.
 



 • Coordinate multidisciplinary workstreams and maintain high delivery standards.
 



  





 Executive Stakeholder Management
 



 • Partner with the CISO and senior leadership to define priorities, decision requirements and risk appetite.
 



 • Lead workshops and translate strategic objectives into clear requirements.
 



 • Manage expectations, trade\-offs and executive communications throughout delivery. Product \& Decision Framework
 



 • Own the product vision and delivery backlog.
 



 • Work with the CISO to develop and operationalise the CRQ decision framework.
 



 • Translate analytical outputs into clear user journeys, decision points and executive narratives.
 



 • Provide direction on information hierarchy, wireframes and visual storytelling. Enterprise Discovery
 



 • Direct research across the organisation to understand the enterprise landscape and gather the information required by the programme.
 



 • Guide questionnaires, stakeholder interviews and evidence collection.
 



 • Identify information gaps and ensure findings are converted into actionable requirements. The Team You will lead a multidisciplinary team including:
 



 • Quantitative Analysts – probabilistic modelling, simulations and analytical methodology.
 



 • Enterprise Researchers – organisational discovery, questionnaires and information gathering.
 



 • Data Engineers – data sourcing, integration and ingestion.
 



 • Power BI Developers – implementation of analytics, dashboards and decision\-support experiences.
 



 • Client SMEs and stakeholders – business, cybersecurity and organisational expertise.
 



  





 The Ideal Candidate
 



 • Proven delivery of large\-scale enterprise technology, data, analytics or BI programmes, including multi\-year engagements of €1m\+.
 



 • Strong consulting experience with C\-suite and senior enterprise stakeholders.
 



 • Hands\-on experience leading Agile delivery and managing product backlogs.
 



 • Experience delivering analytics or BI solutions with Power BI teams.
 



 • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across research, data engineering, analytics and technology.
 



 • Strong product mindset with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into an executable solution.
 



 • Excellent communication, facilitation and visual storytelling skills.
 



 • Strong analytical literacy and the ability to translate complex quantitative outputs into clear business implications.
 



 Desirable
 



 • Experience in cybersecurity, cyber risk, operational risk or enterprise risk.
 



 • Exposure to CRQ or quantitative risk methodologies.
 



 • Experience with executive dashboards or decision\-support products.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



 Success means delivering an end\-to\-end CRQ framework for a clearly defined set of priority risk scenarios. The solution will combine enterprise discovery, quantitative analysis, data engineering and executive reporting into a working operational capability, with automated or real\-time data ingestion and updates where appropriate. The result should provide the CISO and senior leadership with a trusted, current and repeatable view of cyber risk that supports material risk and investment decisions.

d202b520.title: Technical Architect - AWS
d202b520.description:
Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect \& Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high\-level cloud architecture and hands\-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code\-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core.
   

  

 The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high\-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third\-party fleet compliance ecosystems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross\-platform ecosystem integration:
   

  

 Cloud Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Design \& Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high\-velocity streaming data environments.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production\-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments.
* CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time\-to\-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates.
* Security \& Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role\-based access control.


 Backend Software Engineering
   

  

* Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node.js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Data Processing \& AI: Program state\-of\-the\-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e.g., speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking).
* Database \& Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS\-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms.


 Multi\-Platform Ecosystem Integration
   

  

* Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high\-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows.
* Telematics \& Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third\-party systems including:
+ Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real\-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data.
+ Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A\&I, and DataQs datasets).
+ Risk \& Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments.

* Salesforce \& MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end\-to\-end event\-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce.


**Requirements**
 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:
+ Minimum of 5–7 years of proven hands\-on software development experience writing clean production code.
+ Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi\-system integration topographies.

* AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Developer – Associate).
* Technical Proficiency:
+ Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node.js.
+ AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs).
+ Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures.
+ Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment.

* Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data\-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a visionary and hands\-on Enterprise Data Integration Architect to join our Integration Architecture team and serve as the dedicated integration representative to partner with the Data \& AI organization.  The ideal candidate will have deep experience in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and high\-performance integration architectures in partnership with the Enterprise Data Solution Architects to enable advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities. You will collaborate closely with data architects, data engineers, data scientists, and enterprise architects to ensure seamless data flow across systems, domains, and platforms.
   

  

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and drive the integration strategy for data and AI initiatives across the enterprise
* Partner with Data \& AI leadership to align integration architecture with business goals and data strategies
* Evaluate and recommend modern integration technologies and patterns (e.g., event\-driven, API\-led, streaming, data mesh)

**Architecture \& Design**
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration architectures on AWS and/or Azure using services such as Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, S3, Redshift, and others
* Develop integration patterns for real\-time, batch, and near\-real\-time data movement across cloud and hybrid environments
* Ensure data lineage, governance, and observability are embedded in integration designs


**Collaboration \& Enablement**
* Act as the primary liaison between the Integration and Data/AI teams, ensuring alignment and shared understanding
* Mentor and guide integration developers on best practices
* Collaborate with enterprise architects to ensure consistency across platforms and domains


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay abreast of emerging trends in data integration, AI, and cloud technologies
* Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives to evaluate new tools and methodologies
* Contribute to the development of reusable integration assets and frameworks


**Required Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* 10 or more years of experience in enterprise integration architecture, with at least 3 years focused on data\-centric integrations
* Proven experience with AWS data and integration services (Examples: Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, EventBridge, S3, Redshift, or etc.)
* Hands\-on experience building or enabling AI agents in production or advanced POCs
* Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration patterns
* Understanding of MCP
* Experience integrating LLMs via APIs for enterprise use cases
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, Vector database and embeddings, prompt management, tool calling, and agent workflows
* Exposure to Azure cloud services will be a plus
* Exposure to modern data architectures (e.g., data lakehouse, data mesh, real\-time streaming)
* Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, Informatica, or similar
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and observability tools
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance)
* Knowledge of AI/ML pipelines and how integration supports model training and deployment
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices in integration development.
* Certifications in AWS, MuleSoft, or other relevant technologies

a5a5dcb8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team
a5a5dcb8.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy\-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on\-device crash and log management, high\-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high\-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross\-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade\-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade\-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy \& requirements, developing processes \& schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
   

  

* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

**Preferred**

e84e68d4.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a Solutions Architect to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who we hire — the DNA:**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast


**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring:**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform

* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits

* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture

* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Power Limited (APL):** 
 Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for overseeing and managing all operational aspects related to analytics and business integration at the site level within Adani Power Limited. This role focuses on coordinating project management activities, stakeholder engagement, solution deployment, and vendor management to ensure effective implementation of analytics solutions and operational excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Manager**
**Operations And Stakeholder Management**
 Ensure smooth on\-ground operations at the site, overseeing daily activities to maintain operational efficiency.
   

  

 Manage and optimize the financial budget allocated for site operations, ensuring resources are allocated effectively.
   

  

 Build strong relationships with site Heads of Departments (HODs) to identify opportunities for applying analytics to enhance operational effectiveness.
   

  

 Prioritize areas identified for analytics application based on business impact and strategic alignment.
   

  

 Maintain regular communication with leadership to provide updates on site activities and project progress.
   

  

**Awareness And Training**
 Promote awareness of analytics capabilities and organize learning or training programs at the site to enhance team members' skills and knowledge.
   

  

 Coordinate with relevant departments to implement training programs effectively, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
   

  

**Business And Analytics Integration**
 Develop a deep understanding of plant operations, business processes, and opportunities for analytics applications.
   

  

 Participate in site\-level meetings to identify business challenges and collaborate with Business Analysts to develop detailed solutions.
   

  

 Ensure successful implementation of analytics solutions at the site, driving adoption and acceptance among stakeholders.
   

  

**Solution Deployment**
 Review and validate solutions developed by the analytics team, ensuring they meet business requirements and quality standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with the Portfolio Manager to deploy successful initiatives and best practices across other sites within Adani Power Limited.
   

  

 Manage the deployment of solutions, coordinating inputs and feedback from the Portfolio Manager and stakeholders.
   

  

**Vendor And Project Management**
 Manage vendor\-related activities for on\-site operations, including vendor identification, engagement, negotiations, and relationship management.
   

  

 Ensure vendors deliver quality services and products in alignment with project requirements and timelines.
   

  

 Coordinate various aspects of project management at the site, including planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk management.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to quality standards, processes, and consistency in project execution across the site.
   

  

 Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among team members and stakeholders to achieve project goals.
   

  

**Training And Development**
 Identify training needs and opportunities within the plant to enhance skills and knowledge relevant to project and operational requirements.
   

  

 Develop project charters for business problems, define project plans, and oversee their execution to achieve desired outcomes.

 Plant Teams
   

  

 Projects Team
   

  

 Leadership
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Vendors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Power Engineering or a related core discipline)
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 Minimum of 9 years of industry experience, preferably in a plant\-based role.

 Background in power utilities or similar sectors with significant exposure to project management and analytics

**Description**
 At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. We are looking for exceptionally talented and motivated people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for an exceptional leader who is passionate to deliver best in class Customer Experience, who thinks and acts globally, and one who has the ability to invent and simplify processes to join us as Workforce Scheduling Specialist for SAP vertical.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a positive attitude and is a result oriented individual with willingness to work in a 24/7 environment. Candidate should be able to clearly understand in\-scope and out\-scope for delivering end product or service, ensures in time delivery of product or service as per customer expectations without gold plating. Creates and adopts standard work methodology for daily work to reduce re\-work, manual work, error identification time and waste. Clearly communicates to all stakeholders the Timeline, description of end product or service quality, risks and resources needed and is also able to write narratives.

 Key job responsibilities

* Create best capacity plan for business by managing trade\-offs between Customer Experience/Service Levels, Employee Experience, and Cost Effectiveness.
* Develop and improve forecasting models using data analysis and statistical tools.
* Mitigate capacity risks by managing dependencies across multiple operating units. Clearly communicate dependencies and manage/track exceptions.
* Participate in wider SAP projects and initiatives. Candidate will own providing optimal workflow and planning solutions for upcoming initiatives.

 A day in the life

c3605b5b.description:
FEQ227R223
   

  

 As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data \& AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Leader, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid role, based in Bengaluru.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
* You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 15\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role
* 10\+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
* Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
* Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
* Experience building distributed data systems
* Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Available to travel to customers in your region
* Nice to have: Databricks Certification


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

08c4e823.title: Principal Partner Solutions Engineer, SAARC (Based in Bangalore)
08c4e823.description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

 Available Locations
   

  

* Bengaluru, India
* India


**About The Role**
 The Principal Partner Solution Engineer (PSE) is a high\-impact, strategic technical sales leader responsible for end\-to\-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre\-sales and post\-sales engineering activities. In this role, you will act as the single technical point of contact as the trusted advisory for your assigned partners, driving technical validation during the sales cycle, architecting their delivery readiness and ensuring ongoing Partner Success.
   

  

 The role focuses heavily on driving value\-based solution selling to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare platform with focus on One (SASE/SSE) and AI Infrastructure (Workers AI / AI Gateway). By cultivating deeply technical champions within the partner organization, aligning architectures to tangible business outcomes, optimizing post\-sales delivery and building joint managed services offering, you will directly expand and influence the pipeline to maximize Partner\-Influenced Opportunity (PIO) revenue.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Sales Engineering \& Champion Building
* Technical Alignment, Discovery \& Enablement: Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies. Align, build, and accelerate partner technical capabilities, enabling them to lead deep technical discovery and architectural design to independently sell scalable solutions leveraging the Cloudflare Platform with a strong focus on AI and Cloudflare One (CF1\).
* Technical Account Plan Ownership: Own and drive the end\-to\-end Technical Account Plan (TAP) for assigned strategic partners. Act as the primary architect mapping partner business goals to technical execution milestones, ensuring continuous alignment on CF1 and AI adoption targets.
* Building Technical Champions: Identify, enable, and cultivate key technical advocates and "Champions" within the partner organization to scale Cloudflare expertise independently, generate Partner\-Influenced Opportunities (PIO), and empower them to deliver high\-value professional services around Zero Trust and AI application security.
* Driving PIO via Next\-Gen Architectures: Collaborate with sales teams to proactively source, qualify, and expand PIO through strategic architectural alignment, focusing on migrating legacy network architectures to CF1 and integrating secure AI solutions.
* Deal Support \& Qualification: Enable partners' technical validation, proof\-of\-concept (PoC), demo, pipeline generation, and pipeline acceleration capabilities. Identify joint pursuit accounts, facilitate strategic technical account planning, and deliver cutting\-edge solution architecture sessions for Named Partners
* Accelerate Services Delivery
* ASD Partner Journey Ownership: Own the ASD partner journey to ensure partners possess the advanced capabilities required to deploy, manage, and support the Cloudflare platform and AI application workloads seamlessly.
* Joint Services Offering Acceleration with strong focus on CF1 and A1: Build and co\-develop joint services catalogues with key partners, accelerating the creation and launch of their own Cloudflare\-focused services offerings, managed CF1 SASE practices, and AI security assessments.
* Service Monetization \& Performance Metrics: Enable partners to embed CF1 and Workers AI capabilities into their own managed security portfolios to shorten time\-to\-market, protect client AI pipelines, and maximize profitability. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries
* Technical Account Management \& Architectural Health: Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long\-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.
* Automation AI Agents \& Continuous Innovation
* Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high\-touch, strategic partner engagements.
* AI \& CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co\-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.
* Cross\-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross\-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre\-sales scoping and post\-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.


**Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience**
* 8\+ years of technical, partner\-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.
* Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1\) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands\-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.
* Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.
* Enterprise Architecture \& Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi\-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre\-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post\-sale service delivery.
* Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI\-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo** 
 : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers\-\-at no cost.
   

  

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in\-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
   

  

 Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e\-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107\.

* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks

* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure

 Unleash Your Potential
