da2e729c.title: Service Delivery Manager - Offshore
da2e729c.description:
**Company Description**
 Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner \& their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP \& their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
   

  

 The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
   

  

 The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP \& their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals \& ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
   

  

 Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
   

  

 Provide guidance to the PSC \& MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
   

  

 Analyze customer’s business needs \& pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk \& various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues \& leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
   

  

 Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
   

  

 Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
   

  

 Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
   

  

 Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi\-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road\-map.
   

  

 Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC \& SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
   

  

 Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
   

  

 Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
   

  

 Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
   

  

 Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
   

  

 Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
   

  

 Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
   

  

 Identify and fulfill agreed\-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
   

  

 Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
   

  

 Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
   

  

 Maintain updated Action Trackers \& other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
   

  

 Prepare all customer\-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high\-quality standards.
   

  

 Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
   

  

 Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non\-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
   

  

 Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow\-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
   

  

 Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**
* 8 \- 10 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting\-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts


**Key Skills and Attributes:**
* Analytical Expertise: Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* End User Computing (EUC) Mastery: Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* Collaborative Aptitude: Skilled at collaborating with dispersed teams, including CTOs, product management, and support, to deliver the right solutions and innovate based on customer input.
* IT Operations Proficiency: Deep understanding of IT operations.
* Quick Learner: Ability to rapidly acquire knowledge of new technologies.
* Customer\-Centric: Proven ability to gather and manage customer feedback, comprehend customer pain points, and propose practical solutions.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to engage with customers and collaborate effectively within a team.
* Problem Management: Exceptional problem\-solving skills to address complex issues effectively.
* Adaptability: Capability to excel in challenging environments and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Enthusiasm for Innovation: Passion for working in an international, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment and eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Office 365, web browsers, and other standard EUC applications.


**Preferred:**
* Nexthink certified professional / previous experience of working with Nexthink or similar DEM tools.
* Practical knowledge of Windows, Office 365 \& overall EUC insights
* Understanding of SQL, XML, PowerShell, PowerBI would be ideal.
* Practical experience of data integration methods and technologies
+ in any of the following:
+ IT systems
+ Enterprise infrastructure management / Data Centers
+ Application development and management
+ Managed IT Services
+ Security
+ Analytics – EU data

* Project Management skills (ITIL, PMP)


**Additional Information**
 We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real\-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
   

  

 With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
   

  

 If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:
   

  

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with ACKO, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check\-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.
* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company\-paid bank holidays (12\), sick days (10\-30\), bereavement leave (5\), and 3 days per year for volunteering.
* 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
* 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.
* 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.
* 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.
* 📣  Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.


*Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up\-to\-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.*

45534248.description:
**Digital Marketing Delivery Manager** 





 For Digital Marketing Agency located in Kochi
 




  




**Purpose of the Role** 

 Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients.
 



 The
 **Digital Marketing Delivery Manager** 
 owns end\-to\-end scope, strategy, delivery execution, resource efficiency, and client SLAs across all accounts. This role combines deep technical domain knowledge with operational discipline \- ensuring campaigns ship on\-time and on\-scope, while remaining hands\-on to troubleshoot setups, audit strategy, quality, review analytics and optimize internal team throughput.
 



 This role streamlines prioritized workflow, inspires the team do its best work without friction, ensures stakeholder trust and growth prospects.
 


**Reporting** 

**Reports to:** 
 COO / Managing Director
 



**Works with:** 
 Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.
 


**Core Responsibilities** 

**1 Proven experience in Digital Marketing industry standard scope delivery** 




  





 ·    End to end knowledge of holistic digital marketing industry standard scope of work execution successfully.
 



 ·    Ability to take ownership, translate strategies, align with expectations and ensure effective execution, take proactive, corrective and preventive measures throughout workflow process with
 
 ROI focus.
 



 ·    Be hands\-on and actively perform technical audits on paid campaigns and content strategies prior to launch, step in directly to fix technicalities, tracking, campaign structure, or workflow blockers, do overall reviews and provide inputs to SEO, setups, to creatives, for development team etc.
 



 ·    Proficiency in market research, competitor analysis and reporting and familiar with tools like Semrush, MS Clarity, Looker Studio
 **,** 
 popular tools, CRM platforms etc.
 



 ·    Knowledge of AI tools and its leverage to expedite productivity and faster turn arounds.
 



 ·    Strong analytical skills – ability to translate data into clear strategy.
 


**2 Own on\-time delivery across all accounts** 

 •   Hold end\-to\-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.
 



 •   Own scope and maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.
 



 •   Be hands on and streamline productivity and strive for efficiency – individuals and team.
 


**3\. Plan capacity, resource, control workflow, priorities and scope** 

 •   Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over\-allocation
 **before** 
 it causes slippage.
 



 •   Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.
 



 •   Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.
 



 •   Run a disciplined workflow process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.
 



 •   Implement operational frameworks (Agile/Kanban) to maximize team output per hour. Monitor billable vs. non\-billable time and eliminate operational drag across the offshore team.
 



 •   Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade\-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.
 


**5\. Run the delivery cadence** 

 •   Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup \+ weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.
 



 •   Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.
 



 •   Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.
 


**6\. Enforce quality** 

 •   Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.
 



 •   For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA\-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).
 



 •   Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.
 


**7\. Report to clients and leadership** 

 •   Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.
 



 •   Give leadership an honest, data\-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.
 



 •   Standardize daily use of tools (Portal, CRM etc) to maintain 100% visibility into account velocity and resource capacity.
 


**8\. Build the delivery system** 

 •   Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.
 



 •   Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.
 



 •   Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.
 



  




**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 

 Scope Delivery health is measured, reviewed biweekly / monthly, and owned by this role:
 



**Metric** 




**Target** 




 On\-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
 



 Rework rate \< 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
 



 Client\-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
 



 Team utilization 80–90% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
 



 Scope Deliverables/SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
 



 Delivery visibility and Reporting 100% of scope and active work tracked in one live source of truth
 




 with daily, weekly reporting.
 




 Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after.
 


**Qualifications** 

 •   Minimum Graduate with 5 years in digital marketing \& delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.
 



 •   Proven track record of aligning with client requirements, add value by improving quality and scaling on\-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 •   Strong knowledge of Google ads, social media ads, creatives, blogs, email marketing, content, analytics and working knowledge of SEO ,video production, web development \- to get hands on and to judge productivity, quality and timelines.
 



 •   Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.
 



 •   Be updated with latest trends and developments in the digital marketing domain.
 



 •   Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.
 



 •   Organized and Strong on digital marketing workflow design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.
 



 •   Effective English communication skills (spoken and written).
 



 •   Ability to work independently and as part of team, effectively manage priorities and productivity
 



  




**Ideal Candidate** 

 The one who makes digital marketing scope delivery boringly predictable as per stakeholder expectations. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good work ship on time \- every account, every time.
 



 CTC: 6 Lacs Per Annum

ad0eb720.title: Program Manager, Manufacturing & Supply AI Transformation
ad0eb720.description:
**Job title** 
 : Program Manager, Manufacturing \& Supply AI Transformation
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

 As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive the execution of Opella’s Manufacturing \& Supply Data and AI Transformation. This role focuses on translating strategy into action — coordinating cross\-regional initiatives, accelerating delivery, and embedding AI\-enabled capabilities across the global Manufacturing \& Supply network.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strong operator who brings a passion for AI and technology advancement, thrives in complex environments, and excels at orchestrating large\-scale transformation programs with speed and focus. Operating at the heart of the MS.AI Factory, you will convert strategy and a live use\-case pipeline into adopted, value\-generating solutions across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Program Execution \& Delivery
* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of Data \& AI initiatives across Manufacturing \& Supply — from use\-case intake and feasibility assessment through delivery, deployment, and adoption.
* Manage the project portfolio, ensuring alignment with transformation priorities and milestone achievement.
* Drive a high speed of execution through active issue resolution, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Operational Leadership
* Translate strategic direction into clear implementation plans and structured execution frameworks.
* Partner across functions — Manufacturing, Supply, IT, Data Science, Quality, and Finance — to ensure operational readiness and cohesion.
* Maintain disciplined governance across risk management, reporting, and resource planning.
* Challenger Mindset \& Innovation
* Challenge existing processes constructively and introduce innovative, data\-driven ways of working.
* Advocate for modern digital solutions and emerging technologies — including AI, agents, and automation — to drive meaningful improvement.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Engage stakeholders across Europe and India to ensure alignment, collaboration, and adoption.
* Lead change efforts to embed AI, automation, and analytics into operational processes — including Copilot enablement and the AI Champions network.
* Provide clear communication to leadership on progress, risks, and realized benefits.


**About You**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Software \& AI Engineering: Strong hands\-on development skills (Python), with production\-ready software engineering practices — OOP, coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
* Agentic AI \& GenAI: Experience designing and deploying LLM\-powered and agentic solutions (RAG, autonomous and multi\-agent systems), with MCP\-based integrations, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* System Integration: Proven ability to integrate solutions directly into enterprise systems via APIs; exposure to MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) and manufacturing / supply chain data.
* MLOps / AgentOps: Experience operationalizing models and agents — automated build / test / deploy, monitoring, and observability (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow or similar; GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Cloud \& Data: Comfortable in cloud and high\-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines.
* Business Understanding: Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents.
* Experience: \[Add required years] of hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life\-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus.
* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, Engineering, Data/AI) preferred.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience managing large\-scale transformation or digital programs.
* Strong exposure to Manufacturing \& Supply environments, preferably global or regulated.
* Demonstrated experience deploying data, analytics, automation, or AI capabilities at scale.


**Leadership Requirements**
* Passion for AI \& Technology Advancement: demonstrated enthusiasm for new digital technologies and their application in operational environments.
* Speed \& Agility: proven ability to simplify, prioritize, and deliver rapidly.
* Challenger Mindset: constructively challenges historical norms and introduces innovative alternatives.
* Influence \& Collaboration: effective working across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.
* Execution Excellence: strong structure, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Comfort with Ambiguity: navigates shifting priorities and complex environments confidently.


**Technical Requirements**
* AI/ML Lifecycle: understanding of model development, deployment, and monitoring.
* Frameworks \& Tools: familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data engineering tools (SQL, Python, Spark).
* Cloud \& Governance: experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise data governance.
* Business Translation: ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and operational outcomes.


**Soft \& Behavioral Skills**
* Challenger Mindset: proactively questions the status quo and drives innovation and pace across the transformation portfolio.
* All In, Together: builds strong, collaborative relationships across global, cross\-functional, and partner teams.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: relentlessly focused on delivering measurable business impact and realized benefits, not just activity.
* Courageous: takes ownership, makes decisions in ambiguity, and drives initiatives through to completion.
* Radically Simple: brings clarity and simplicity to complex programs, stakeholders, and reporting.


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

* This role is critical to accelerating Opella’s digital capability across Manufacturing \& Supply. The Program Manager will ensure strategic direction is executed effectively, driving measurable improvements across Europe, India, and the broader global network.


 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

bda88887.description:

Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Program Manager – Components**
**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager for Components \& Sub\-Systems is responsible for the end\-to\-end execution and delivery of a defined portion of a Fluence product or program, such as an electrical component, electronic subsystem, battery\-related subsystem, power electronics module, charging system, embedded controller, software module, or technical workstream.
   

  

 This role is ideally suited to candidates with experience delivering electrical and electronic products through development, validation, manufacturing readiness, and production launch. The successful candidate will drive timing, quality, cost, and readiness objectives while coordinating across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product Management teams.
   

  

 The Program Manager owns schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, supplier coordination, and launch readiness activities for their assigned scope and is accountable for ensuring successful integration into the broader product platform.
   

  

 Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in battery systems, energy storage systems and Control software developments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of assigned subsystems/workstreams from requirements through validation, launch and production readiness.
* Develop and manage program plans, schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies and mitigation actions to ensure on\-time delivery.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, and external suppliers.
* Coordinate subsystem integration and readiness across hardware, software, manufacturing, procurement and validation activities.
* Manage engineering changes, launch readiness, issue resolution, and provide structured status updates to leadership.
* Build stakeholder alignment, proactively escalate risks, and support regulatory, compliance, and customer deliverables.


**Required Qualifications**

* 3–7 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing or related technical roles.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional delivery of hardware and/or software development programs.
* Experience managing Embedded software components, electrical and/or electronic components or subsystems through development, validation, supplier engagement, manufacturing readiness and production launch.
* Strong experience with schedule management, risk management, milestone planning, dependency management, and executive communication.
* Proven ability to drive execution and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience working within multinational engineering or product development environments.


**Strongly Preferred Experience**
 Candidates with hands\-on experience in one or more of the following areas will be strongly preferred:
   

  

* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
* Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Power Conversion Systems (PCS)
* Renewable energy plants
* Embedded software development
* Semiconductor Products
* Electrical/Electronic Subsystem Integration


**Preferred Skills**
* Component Lifecycle Management
* Product Validation \& Verification
* Manufacturing Readiness \& Production Launch
* Engineering Change Management
* Agile, Scrum, Stage\-Gate, or Hybrid Product Development Processes
* Embedded Software, Firmware, API, or Software Integration experience


**Preferred Certifications**
* PMP (Required)
* Scrum Master / Agile Certification
* SAFe Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification


**Candidates who have applied within the past six months need not apply.**
 Qualified candidates are requested to submit a resume and cover letter at careers@fluenceenergy.com for consideration.

 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

16495c18.title: Technical Program Manager, Program Lead Engineer
16495c18.description:
**The Impact You’ll Make**
 As a leading global supplier of wafer fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry, Lam Research develops innovative solutions that help our customers build smaller, faster, and more power\-efficient devices.
   

  

 We are a company comprised of people who work hard, deliver outstanding results, and maintain a sense of humor during even the most challenging times. Our success results from our employees' diverse technical and business expertise, which fuels close collaboration and ongoing innovation. We know that our dynamic, global team of exceptional employees is essential to our continued growth.
   

  

 Join the Lam Research team, where you can play a vital role in the future of electronics and write your own success story.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are looking for a senior engineer who combines deep manufacturing quality expertise with the ability to drive Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled transformation. This person will operate at the intersection of engineering, data, and software delivery — translating real\-world manufacturing and quality business rules into specifications that engineering and Information Technology (IT) teams can build, then validating that what gets built works on the shop floor.
   

  

 This is not a traditional quality engineer role and not a traditional software role — it is a hybrid "translator" position for someone who understands parts, drawings, and process data as fluently as they understand how to scope a business rule for a development team.
   

  

* Define and codify manufacturing and quality business rules by analyzing engineering drawings, GD\&T requirements, supplier/manufacturing data, inspection records, and critical\-to\-quality characteristics across a variety of commodities and manufacturing processes.
* Translate engineering and quality domain knowledge into clear, testable requirements that IT, software developers, data engineers, and contractors can implement in automation and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Apply advanced quality and statistical engineering methods including SPC, DOE, Gage R\&R, gage matching, control charts, and Type I/Type II error analysis to validate measurement systems, process performance, and solution accuracy.
* Partner with technical teams throughout the development lifecycle to review business logic, identify edge cases, guide solution design, test functionality, and ensure automation and AI solutions accurately reflect real\-world manufacturing requirements.
* Lead AI\-enabled process transformation initiatives end\-to\-end — identifying high\-value opportunities, determining when AI versus deterministic automation is appropriate, developing the business case, defining requirements, validating results, and driving successful implementation and adoption


**Who We’re Looking For**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Minimum 10 years of experience with a bachelor’s degree, or minimum 6 years of experience with a master’s degree.
   

  

* Proven experience in manufacturing, supplier quality, process engineering, or digital transformation roles.
* Strong knowledge of engineering drawings, GD\&T, SPC, DOE, Gage R\&R, and quality systems.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, SQL, Minitab, JMP, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and their application in manufacturing environments.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects and communicate effectively with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A track record of leading or co\-leading process improvement or digital transformation initiatives from idea through implementation and validation
* Practitioner of Lean Six Sigma techniques
* Experience managing suppliers remotely.
* Experience working with SAP databases or other database systems.


**Our commitment**
 We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
   

  

 Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
   

  

*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on\-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On\-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On\-site Flex’ you’ll work 3\+ days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1\-2 days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. **Job Summary**
 As a Solution Architect at Empower, you will be a hands\-on technical leader and solution\-shaping architecture contributor supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO. You will partner with business leaders, Business and Enterprise Architects, product owners, cybersecurity, engineering, operations, data, and vendor teams to translate business outcomes, regulatory obligations, and operational needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective end\-to\-end solutions.
   

  

 The role spans SaaS platforms, cloud services, applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure, with particular emphasis on ServiceNow and AWS. You will guide initiatives from discovery through implementation, define target\-state and reference architectures, document decisions and trade\-offs, and establish reusable patterns and guardrails. You will also support the broader shared\-services technology landscape, including Atlassian Jira and Confluence, Palantir Foundry, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, while ensuring solutions are supportable, observable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.

* Create and maintain architecture deliverables such as current\-state and target\-state views, context and logical diagrams, deployment models, data flows, integration designs, nonfunctional requirements, architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and transition plans.
* Serve as a ServiceNow architecture lead, defining scalable platform and solution designs across workflows, the platform data model, CSDM and CMDB, integrations, identity and security, custom applications, environment strategy, performance, upgradeability, and platform governance. Evaluate fit\-to\-platform and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Design AWS solutions aligned with AWS Well\-Architected principles across identity and access management, networking, compute, storage, databases, integration, observability, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Define and guide infrastructure automation using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable templates and modules, source control, automated validation, environment promotion, secrets handling, policy guardrails, and stack, state, and drift management.
* Embed DevOps and DevSecOps practices into solution designs, including CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, release and rollback strategies, monitoring and logging, alerting, incident readiness, and operational handoff.
* Architect secure, reusable integration patterns across SaaS platforms, AWS, on\-premises systems, and vendor ecosystems using APIs, events, messaging, files, and data pipelines. Define contracts, authentication, error handling, observability, and lifecycle governance.
* Guide relational database architecture for SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including data design, performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, migration, and appropriate use of AWS managed database services.
* Provide architecture oversight through delivery by reviewing detailed designs, guiding engineering teams, leading proofs of concept, resolving cross\-system dependencies, and verifying implementation against approved architecture.
* Evaluate technologies and vendor solutions, advise on build, buy, and configure decisions, and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, rationalize, and optimize the shared\-services application portfolio and run cost.
* Contribute to architecture standards, design\-review forums, reusable patterns, decision records, and lessons learned. Communicate recommendations, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* At least 5 years of progressive experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including ownership of end\-to\-end solution design for multiple moderately to highly complex initiatives.
* Demonstrated ServiceNow solution or platform architecture experience in a large enterprise environment \- not solely platform administration or development \- including translating business requirements into platform capabilities and governing implementation.
* Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including but not limited to, application scopes, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, APIs, and platform configuration.
* Strong AWS architecture experience and working knowledge across core cloud domains, with the ability to evaluate security, resilience, operational, performance, and cost trade\-offs.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable components and automated deployment workflows.
* DevOps or DevSecOps experience with Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, and production supportability.
* Enterprise application and integration architecture experience across SaaS, cloud, and on\-premises systems, with strong knowledge of API, event, identity, and data integration patterns.
* Experience designing solutions using both SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and migration considerations.
* Ability to define and evaluate functional and nonfunctional requirements and to design for privacy, security, auditability, segregation of duties, records management, and other controls appropriate to sensitive or regulated environments.
* Strong architecture modeling and documentation skills, with experience in design reviews, architecture decision records, reference patterns, and implementation governance.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and explain technical decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to varied audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience with ServiceNow capabilities relevant to shared services, such as ITSM, ITOM, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Integrated Risk Management or GRC, Legal Service Delivery, App Engine or Workflow Studio, Integration Hub, MID Server, CSDM, and CMDB.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional, and/or a HashiCorp Terraform certification.
* Enterprise architecture or administration experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, including workflows, permissions, automation, integrations, Marketplace app governance, and cloud or data\-center lifecycle management.
* Palantir Foundry experience, including data integration and pipelines, Ontology modeling, application or workflow enablement, security and governance, and production lifecycle practices.
* Experience supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, or Office of the CIO technology capabilities in a regulated enterprise.

* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Agile or product operating models, SaaS and platform lifecycle management, vendor evaluation, cloud financial management or FinOps, and application rationalization.


 Education

**Interior Designer – Pre\-Sales / Furniture Sales** 




**Location:** 
 Alankaram Showroom, Bengaluru

 3–7 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 About the Role

 **Interior Designer with strong client\-facing skills** 
 to join the Pre\-Sales team at our Bengaluru showroom.

 **interior design, furniture proportions, materials, finishes, space planning and aesthetics** 
 . You will work closely with homeowners, architects and interior designers to help them select and customise furniture suited to their spaces.
 



 The role offers an opportunity to combine
 **design knowledge with commercial and client\-management skills** 
 , with a clear career path towards
 **Senior Pre\-Sales Designer, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager** 
 .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Attend to clients visiting the Bengaluru showroom and understand their requirements, lifestyle, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend appropriate furniture, materials, finishes, fabrics, colours and configurations.
* Help clients visualise how furniture will work within their interiors in terms of
 **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language** 
 .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior\-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
 **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility** 
 .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long\-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow\-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre\-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back\-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



**Education** 




 Bachelor's / Diploma in:
 


* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.



**Experience** 




 Ideally
 **3–7 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following:
 


* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials



 Previous sales experience is useful but
 **not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client\-facing ability and commercial orientation** 
 .
 



 Essential Skills
 



 The candidate should have:
 


* Strong understanding of
 **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow\-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences



 Particularly Important for This Role
 



 We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:
 



**“What kind of home are you creating?”** 




 to
 



**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”** 




 and eventually to:
 



**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”** 




 The candidate therefore needs to be
 **a designer first, but commercially minded** 
 .
 



  





 Performance Indicators
 


* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk\-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation\-to\-order conversion %
* Follow\-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior\-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business



  





 Career Growth
 



 A strong candidate should be able to progress through:
 



**Interior Designer – Pre\-Sales** 




 →
 **Senior Pre\-Sales Designer** 




 →
 **Assistant Sales Manager** 




 →
 **Sales Manager / Showroom Manager** 




 →
 **Zonal Sales Manager** 




 →
 **Regional Sales Manager** 




  





**You should have:** 



* Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
* 3\+ years relevant experience
* Strong design and aesthetic understanding
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confidence dealing with premium clients
* Ability to understand drawings and space plans
* Strong ownership and follow\-up skills
* A commercial mindset and willingness to work towards sales goals


- 


**Why join Alankaram?** 




 Build expertise in premium furniture and client advisory while developing a career beyond conventional interior\-design roles.
 



 Strong performers can grow into
 **Senior Pre\-Sales, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager roles** 
 .
 



  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Role:** 
 Full\-time, showroom\-based

01cba682.title: Program Manager: Development & Makerspace Curriculum
01cba682.description:
We are looking for a Program Manager to lead our K\-12 Makerspace and Innovation programs from concept to classroom. You will guide a cross\-functional team of developers, designers, and curriculum specialists to build engaging, hands\-on learning experiences. You will also work directly with schools and educators to make sure the programs deliver real learning outcomes.
 




  





**Program \& Team Leadership** 



* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the development team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Run regular reviews and report progress to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team of Full Stack, Frontend (FE), and Backend (BE) developers, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Manage releases, code review cycles, and QA handoffs with the engineering team.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Report progress to leadership and stakeholders.



  





**Curriculum Design (K\-12\)** 



* Design and oversee age\-appropriate, project\-based curriculum for Grades K\-12 in areas such as robotics, electronics, coding, 3D printing, design thinking, and STEAM.
* Align curriculum with relevant frameworks (NEP 2020, NGSS, CBSE/ICSE, IB, or others, as applicable).
* Create lesson plans, project kits, assessment rubrics, and teacher guides.
* Review and update content regularly using classroom feedback and learning outcomes.
* **Lead the design function:** 
  define design roles (UI/UX, learning material, and Makerspace/kit designers), set design standards, and manage design reviews and timelines.
* Work with designers to turn wireframes and prototypes into working features, keeping design and engineering aligned through handoffs in Figma and GitHub.
* Translate educational goals into clear user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria for Full Stack, FE, and BE developers.
* Oversee the development of learning platforms, dashboards, and digital tools, from prototype to launch.
* Own the product backlog and roadmap, balancing technical constraints, timelines, and classroom needs.



  




 Customer Training \& Enablement
 * **Design the customer training framework** 
  for schools, teachers, administrators, and students, including onboarding, certification, and ongoing professional development.
* Create training materials such as workshop decks, teacher guides, video tutorials, hands\-on kit guides, quick\-start manuals, and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training in multiple formats: in\-person workshops, virtual sessions, and self\-paced modules.
* **Build and manage a trainer team** 
  (internal trainers, master trainers, or partners), including training\-the\-trainer programs and quality standards.
* Schedule and coordinate training across schools, managing logistics, timelines, and resources.
* Track training effectiveness through attendance, feedback scores, teacher confidence, adoption rates, and student outcomes.
* Continuously improve training content using classroom observations and customer feedback.
* Set up support channels (helpdesk, community, office hours) to keep customers successful after training.



  





**Product \& Design Collaboration** 



* Work with designers on learning materials, digital platforms, and Makerspace layouts.
* Translate educational goals into clear requirements for the development team.
* Oversee the development of learning tools, platforms, or kits, from prototype to launch.



  





**Customer \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the main contact for schools, administrators, and educators.
* Conduct product demos, pilot programs, and workshops.
* Gather feedback from teachers and students and turn it into program improvements.
* Support Makerspace setup, teacher onboarding, and ongoing training.



  




 Program \& Team Leadership
 * Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* **Design and build the program team:** 
  define roles and team structure across Full Stack, Frontend, Backend, design, and curriculum, and plan capacity as programs grow.
* **Lead hiring and onboarding** 
  for developers, designers, curriculum designers, and trainers, working with HR and leadership.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Set team goals and KPIs, conduct regular performance check\-ins, and mentor team members.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.



  




 Required Qualifications
 * **Master's degree** 
  (M.Tech, MBA, or equivalent) with a 
 **B.Tech / B.E.** 
  in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **12\+ years of experience** 
  in program or project management, ideally in EdTech, STEM education, or innovation programs, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience leading and scaling cross\-functional teams of Full Stack, Frontend, and Backend developers and designers.
* Experience building and managing teams, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
* Working understanding of the software development lifecycle, web application architecture, APIs, and databases, with the ability to discuss technical trade\-offs.
* Hands\-on experience designing K\-12 curriculum, especially for Makerspace, STEM/STEAM, or innovation labs.
* Experience designing and delivering training programs for teachers, educators, or enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of project\-based learning and design thinking.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering product demos, client sessions, and leadership presentations.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (Jira, Asana, Trello, Figma, GitHub, or similar).

888da5fe.title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
888da5fe.description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have
   

  

 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaSWorking command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-readyPresence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same roomHands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of oneExperience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access controlWriting that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually readEngineering background is a must
   

  

 Nice to have
   

  

 Contact centre or CX domain backgroundExposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyersMultilingual or Arabic deployment experienceTime at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery
   

  

 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, WFOOur customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office dayOccasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support
   

  

 WHY THIS SEAT
   

  

 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
   

  

 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.

 Job Category

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers.  *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best*

884c8bbc.title: Lead Solutions Architect – SAP Platform
884c8bbc.description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 This position plays a significant role in the definition and implementation of our over\-arching SAP S/4 solutions and applications strategy, including functional roadmaps, architecture, design and implementation for Supply Chain solutions. This role performs work that is highly complex, varied in nature, and spans multiple functional areas. It also seeks to ensure optimum utilization of existing core platforms and their integration while considering and / or facilitating the justified deployment of new technologies in response to business requirements. As a Lead Solution Architect, you will be part of our SAP Platform \& Strategic Initiatives team. In this role you are responsible for guiding strategic thought leadership across our SAP ecosystem, including functional \& technical design \& architecture, coaching \& mentoring broader talent, and successful delivery of strategic initiatives projects.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead or advise on Supply Chain (Plan, Source, Make, Inventory Pillars) solutions roadmap and projects.
* Understand supply chain business processes and requirements related to SAP solutions by engaging through D\&T with business partners and SAP practitioners at enterprise level.
* Conduct comparative research and recommend strategies with regards to SAP technologies to propose and implement solutions for business needs.
* Perform discovery projects by engaging with business units and SAP team members to find the best possible solutions for GMI.
* Lead, consult or participate in end\-to\-end implementations while also engaging as a functional solution architect in other parallel SAP projects
* Craft adaptable, comprehensive, and feasible solutions by creating necessary blueprint documents for functional requirements and technical specifications.
* Lead, review and/or participate in solution design, build, test and go live activities on SAP Supply Chain solutions implementations, rollouts, or upgrade projects.
* Learn and understand existing system landscape to be able to design solutions for efficient and effective integration of SAP systems with other business applications.
* Review current standards and continuously revise to ensure best practices.
* Serve as the conduit through D\&T to enable businesses and technology.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, or Business from an accredited institution or equivalent
* 10\+ years of progressive SAP solutioning hands on experience leading up to architect level work.
* Deep expertise in one or more SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4 modules such as Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), Inventory Management (IM), Quality Management (QM), WM (Warehouse Management)
* Experience in multiple S/4 implementations with focus on specific supply chain areas, examples production planning, production execution, procurement, inventory management and integration with other S/4 capabilities or 3rd party systems (MES, 3PL etc.)
* Knowledge of respective cross\-functional integration with order management, transportation management and Finance processes.
* Hands\-on experience with complex and large\-scale SAP project implementations.
* Working through broader organization teams and external partners for the successful delivery of end\-to\-end solutions
* Ability to convert business challenges into technical solutions.
* Time management skills and the ability to prioritize multiple parallel activities.
* Collaborative nature with a strong focus on enabling team culture. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and collaboration with team members across multiple geographies; 3rd party team members \& vendors
* Willingness to work off business hours as needed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of required SAP localizations for the geographies where GMI has business operation (Europe, Brazil, Asian countries).
* Waterfall and agile project management expertise
* Experience using integration tools (ex WebMethods, APIs technologies, etc)
* Experience in automated testing tools and methodologies.

 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)

* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)

 Unleash Your Potential

8e3914b1.description:
**Role Description**
**Enterprise Architect \- Regional, eStore \& Core Platform Migrations**
**Role Summary**
 The Enterprise Architect will lead
 **end to end architecture for regional migrations to STEP platform and eStore related initiatives (Major systems in the platform include SAP, S4/Hana, Salesforce, IIB, Informatica, MDM and custom home grown applications) ,** 
 analyze
 **impact, integration, and transition** 
 .
   

  

 This role needs understanding of the current business process including but not limited to
 **customer, order to cash, finance, and reporting flows and** 
 cloud architecture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**CRM \& ERP Architecture**
* Own enterprise level architecture for Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA as part of regional and eStore migrations.
* Define target state interaction patterns, including but not limited to:
+ Customer, account, and contact mastering
+ Quote to cash / order to cash flows
+ Pricing, invoicing, and revenue recognition touchpoints

* Ensure data consistency and ownership boundaries between Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, and downstream systems.


**Migration Architecture \& Strategy**
* Design and govern migration paths for CRM, ERP, and dependent applications, including phased cutovers and coexistence strategies.
* Lead impact analysis for Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA when migrating:
+ Country specific systems
+ eStore platforms and digital sales channels

* Ensure business continuity for sales operations, finance, and reporting during migration waves, including SAP backed analytics and dashboards.


**Integration \& Data Architecture**
* Define and govern integration patterns across:
+ Salesforce SAP S/4HANA
+ eStore Salesforce
+ SAP Enterprise Data Platforms / reporting (e.g., BOBJ, enterprise dashboards)

* Oversee data migration and reconciliation for:
+ Customers, products, pricing, orders, and financial data

* Ensure alignment with enterprise data models and source of truth principles.


**Enterprise Architecture Governance**
* Enforce EA standards, canonical models, and integration contracts for CRM and ERP domains.
* Review and approve Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA solution designs through Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
* Ensure migrated CRM/ERP assets are correctly registered, owned, and auditable in enterprise architecture repositories.


**Security, Compliance \& Controls**
* Ensure Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA migrations meet:
+ GDPR and EU regulatory requirements
+ Enterprise security, access control, and audit standards

* Define role based access, data classification, and segregation of duties across CRM and ERP platforms.


**Stakeholder Alignment**
* Partner with Sales, Finance, eCommerce, Product, and Regional IT leaders to align migration outcomes with business priorities.
* Act as the single architectural authority connecting business flows (including but not limited to) (lead order cash report) to technical execution.


**Core Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years in Enterprise Architecture / Solution Architecture with large scale transformations.
* Proven experience leading Salesforce and SAP (ECC or S/4HANA) migration or transformation programs.
* Experience with multi country or regional ERP/CRM rollouts, preferably in Europe.


**Platform \& Domain Expertise**
* Salesforce: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, core CRM data models, and integration patterns.
* SAP S/4HANA: Finance, order to cash concepts, and integration with non SAP platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM\-ERP integration, master data management, and financial controls.


**Architecture \& Integration**
* API led and event driven integration patterns.
* Data migration, reconciliation, and cutover strategies.
* Cloud and hybrid architectures (Azure preferred).


**Nice to Have**
* eCommerce / eStore platform migrations integrated with Salesforce.
* Experience with SAP BOBJ or enterprise reporting platforms consuming SAP data.
* Prior involvement in audit heavy or compliance driven migrations.


**Success Measures**
* Zero disruption to sales, billing, and financial close during migration.
* Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA operating as cleanly integrated, governed enterprise platforms post migration.
* Reusable CRM/ERP migration patterns for future countries or acquisitions.


**Skills**
 enterprise application architecture,solution architecture,sap s4hana,salesforce cloud,
