b084a3d8.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

 We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.

**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience


**Work Timings:**

Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. 81625fc6.description:
Job Title: OCI Cloud Architect
 



 Location: Chennai /Hybrid
 



 Experience: 15 \+ Years
 



 Support time: UK Time Zone
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Job Summary We are seeking an experienced OCI Cloud Architect to manage and support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments across Development, UAT, and Production, including Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments. The role requires strong expertise in cloud security, application hosting, patching, upgrades, CI/CD pipelines, and the design of highly available and disaster\-resilient architectures.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the architecture and day\-to\-day operation of the OCI compartments across production, DR and non\-production tiers (DEV, TST, UAT, QA, SIT).
* Maintain secure, scalable, highly available designs across regions, including VCN design, DRG/FastConnect connectivity, load balancing and public/private access separation.
* Manage Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments on OCI.
* Implement and manage OCI security including IAM, policies, compartments, and access controls.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
* Host, Migration, operate, and support enterprise applications on OCI, including Oracle EBS.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for OCI provisioning and configuration.
* Design and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for OCI and EBS.
* Run vulnerability management and enforce security and governance standards — IAM policies, compartments, identity services, auditing and logging — within the customer's retained identity and security governance model.
* Design and maintain HA and DR, including Data Guard, remote peering and application failover; run DR tests and evidence RTO/RPO attainment.
* Perform DR testing, failover exercises, and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
* Apply shift\-left automation to reduce repeat incidents, and support FinOps review of compute, load balancer and storage consumption.
* Operate within the customer's change management (CAB), incident and problem management processes, respecting tenant ownership and break\-glass controls retained by the customer.
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.
* Excellent troubleshooting and stakeholder communication; comfortable working within a shift roster.
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and cost across OCI and EBS environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, database, and application issues across all environments.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity and cost; troubleshoot across infrastructure, database and platform layers.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; participate in service governance and reporting against SLA/XLA measures.
* Collaborate with application, database, DevOps, and security teams.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Experience: 15 \+ Years
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Deep hands\-on OCI experience — networking, security, governance, compartment and tenancy design, multi\-region architecture.
* Proven experience running Oracle EBS environments at the infrastructure, OS and database layers, in a shared\-responsibility model alongside an application partner.
* Oracle Database 19c on Exadata (Exadata VM clusters / DB Systems), Data Guard, backup and recovery.
* Terraform and CI/CD pipeline delivery; automation\-first operating mindset.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Proven experience managing Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) hosted environments.
* Experience supporting Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Strong understanding of OCI networking, Security, and governance.
* Expertise in Oracle EBS administration, patching, cloning, Migration and upgrades.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of High Availability and Disaster Recovery architectures.
* Experience with Oracle Databases (Autonomous, DB Systems, Exadata preferred).
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred Skills**

**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Staff AI \& Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable AI platforms and intelligent solutions on AWS. This role requires deep expertise across AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, MLOps, and Generative AI, along with strong experience in building enterprise\-grade, secure, and compliant SaaS platforms.
   

  

 You will be responsible for architecting end\-to\-end AI systems, enabling machine learning and deep learning engineering workflows, and driving innovation in GenAI and agentic AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, data architecture, and applied AI, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and governance.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Platform \& Solution Architecture**
* Design and build scalable, multi\-tenant AI platforms on AWS supporting diverse ML and GenAI use cases.
* Define reference architectures, reusable components, and best practices for AI/ML systems.
* Architect end\-to\-end AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Ensure platform readiness for SaaS environments, including tenant isolation, scalability, and cost optimization.


**Machine Learning \& Deep Learning Engineering**
* Lead development of machine learning and deep learning models for production\-grade applications.
* Establish standards for ML engineering, including data preprocessing, feature stores, training pipelines, and inference services.
* Optimize model performance, scalability, and latency for real\-time and batch inference systems.


**Generative AI \& Agentic AI Systems**
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and foundation models.
* Build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases and embeddings.
* Develop agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integration.
* Apply advanced techniques such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.


**AWS Cloud Architecture**
* Architect and implement solutions using:
* AWS SageMaker (training, pipelines, deployment)
* AWS Bedrock (GenAI services)
* Compute: Lambda, ECS, EKS
* Orchestration: Step Functions
* Storage/Data: S3, Redshift, DynamoDB, Glue
* Build highly available, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized cloud\-native systems.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.


**MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management**
* Establish and scale MLOps frameworks for continuous integration and deployment of ML models.
* Implement MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
* Build automated CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows.
* Enable model monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and explainability.


**Data Architecture \& Engineering**
* Design scalable data architectures to support AI/ML workloads (batch and streaming).
* Implement data pipelines, feature stores, and data governance frameworks.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, and accessibility across teams.


**Security, Compliance \& Governance**
* Architect AI systems with security\-first principles, including encryption, IAM, and network controls.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2 as applicable).
* Implement responsible AI practices, including bias detection, auditability, and explainability.
* Establish governance for data, models, and AI services.


**SaaS Platform Engineering**
* Design and implement AI\-powered SaaS platforms, supporting:
+ Multi\-tenancy and tenant isolation
+ API\-driven architectures
+ Usage metering and cost attribution

* Enable platform extensibility and integration with enterprise systems.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship across AI, ML, and cloud engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI paradigms.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (PhD preferred) with a minimum of 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, and cloud architecture.
* Good expertise in Machine Learning Engineering and Deep Learning Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, core cloud services)
* MLflow and MLOps frameworks
* Good programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
* Proven experience designing and deploying scalable AI systems in production.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation).
* Good understanding of data architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience implementing secure and compliant cloud solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks and multi\-agent systems.
* Familiarity with LLM orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS).
* Knowledge of streaming and big data technologies (Kafka, Spark).
* AWS certifications:
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty
* Experience in enterprise SaaS platforms or regulated industries.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Expertise in scalable AI system design
* Good foundation in ML, DL, and GenAI
* Deep knowledge of MLOps and cloud\-native architectures
* Excellent problem\-solving and system design skills
* Good communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to balance innovation with enterprise constraints (security, compliance, cost)


**Impact of the Role**
 This role will be instrumental in shaping the organization’s AI platform strategy and execution, enabling rapid development and deployment of next\-generation AI solutions, including Generative AI and agentic systems, while ensuring scalability, security, and compliance at enterprise scale.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

7a84eda4.title: Program Manager, Operations - Tamil Nadu
7a84eda4.description:
**About Mitti Labs**
 Mitti Labs is a climate\-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.
   

  

 Backed by NASA\-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net\-zero goals through verified, high\-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.
   

  

 Our customers \- including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri\-businesses \- trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40\+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.
   

  

**Role Description**
 Mitti Labs is entering Tamil Nadu as we expand our climate\-smart agriculture programs across key rice\-growing regions. We are looking for a strong, strategic state lead/project lead who can build and manage Tamil Nadu operations from inception and ensure seamless execution of our carbon projects.
   

  

 Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100\. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.
   

  

 Some of your objectives will include:
   

  

* Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre\-defined roadmap
* Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
* Continually training, re\-training, and supporting the field agent force
* Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?


 We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* External Partner Operations Management
* Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
* Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
* Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
* Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc
* Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner's teams (at managerial and operational levels)
* Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks
* Internal Communications
* Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R\&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
* Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
* Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
* Offer support on Science Ops, R\&D ops, agronomic demos, etc
* Operational Execution and Leadership
* Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on\-ground execution
* Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
* Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
* Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
* Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
* Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
* Build marketing material in coordination with on\-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
* Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs \+ Video walkthroughs


**Requirements**
 Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:
   

  

* Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
* Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
* Experience in Agri Project Management
* Strong communication skills and composure when dealing with large scale projects and large teams
* Process excellence mindset
* People management. High cultural sensitivity and ability to motivate rural teams.
* Ability to pre\-empt issues and offer solutions to fire\-fight
* Willingness to travel to fields on daily basis
* Ability to understand and engage with agrarian communities, understanding of farmers, FPOs, NGOs, Government Departments, etc..


**Experience:**
* Strong professional experience (7\+ years) \- ideally in agri\-project management, field extension management, input distribution/sales
* Category experience in Paddy farming is strongly preferred
* Proven experience in optimizing processes and building systems and strategies to support scale
* Strong educational background, preferably in Agribusiness management, Field Extension management, operations / supply chain strategy type roles
* Experience managing large field teams (100\-300 people) through partner organizations or direct teams
* Demonstrated capability in building high\-performance cultures, coaching mid\-level managers, and creating accountability systems
* Strong ability to create MIS, and monitor KPIs at scale
* Hands\-on experience using project management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, Excel, Looker Studio, etc.)
* Experience in multi\-district or multi\-state program rollouts
* Prior experience implementing QA/QC frameworks, audits, field validation checks, and adherence to SOP
* Experience in generating detailed stakeholder\-specific reports and documentation to synthesize findings and learnings to diverse stakeholders
* Experience ensuring compliance with carbon methodologies, government schemes, donor requirements, or agri certification programs
* Native fluency in Tamil is a must


**Benefits**
 Purpose driven work \- tackling the worlds most pressing challenges \- climate change, food security, water security, farmer livelihoods improvement.
   

  

 Culture / Team / Environment \- our team includes the best minds in science, product, business and operations, in an environment where collaboration and openness is highly valued, unbiased, objective decision making, direct relationship with founders, and encouragement of career growth in a rapidly scaling organization.
   

  

 Exposure to multiple stakeholders \- internal and external, ability to operate at the center of the organization.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please apply through this Google Form link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7JBre\_oKXlgFlgErc66XFqcZfTkc8Gjo\_QWLDEesTCPpCWw/viewform

Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast\-paced, multi\-client environment.

 Your Experience Having experience of 10\+ years in handling Central government \& Defence departments.  We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Salesforce Architect who can lead and deliver complex Salesforce solutions for our clients in various industries. You will define the Salesforce strategy, architecture, integration, development, and security of multiple Salesforce applications across sales, service, and marketing clouds. You will also work with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and collaborate with other vendors.

* Work with CXO\-level stakeholders to understand their business needs, present solutions, and manage expectations

* Manage project teams, vendors, budgets, timelines, and quality assurance activities
* Stay updated on the latest trends and developments in Salesforce and CRM domains
* Develop trust\-based relationships with clients as a trusted C\-level advisor
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality products that exceed client expectations
* Support the professional development of your team members through coaching and feedback
* Contribute to the intellectual capital of the firm by creating knowledge documents on a specific content platform


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 8 t0 14 years of experience in IT Architecture, Technology transformation, Salesforce architecture and development
* Salesforce Application Architect and System Architect certifications
* Experience in leading and delivering complex Salesforce solutions using sales cloud, marketing cloud, service cloud, and marketing cloud for at least 5\-10 clients in target industries

a5ba3e81.title: ERP ALM Solution Architect -  Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
a5ba3e81.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future\-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.
   

  

 Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom\-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:
   

  

****Architect the Pivot:****
 Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high\-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud\-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.
   

  

****Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning:****
 You will orchestrate the end\-to\-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.
   

  

****Govern Hybrid Landscapes:****
 You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP\-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Mastery of ALM Transition \& Toolsets: Expert\-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM
* 8\+ years of Custom Build \& Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom\-built enterprise software or side\-by\-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence
* SDLC \& DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API\-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration
* Advanced competency in using AI\-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings
* Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full\-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade\-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions
* Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom\-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards
* Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders
* English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

2bda37e1.title: Pre-Sales Executive
2bda37e1.description:
We're hiring a Pre\-Sales Executive at 403Labs. Remote.
 



  





 We run marketing for a set of interior design studios, and the leads are coming in. What's missing is someone who can actually work them — pick up the phone, understand what the client is trying to build, qualify whether it's a real project, and keep the conversation alive until they're ready to sit down with the design team.
 



  





 This is not a call\-centre script role. You're often the first human a homeowner speaks to about a project they've been thinking about for months. How that call feels decides whether they show up.
 



  





 What the role involves:
 



 • Calling and qualifying inbound leads across our interior design clients
 



 • Understanding scope, timeline and budget readiness before passing a lead forward
 



 • Following up consistently — most of these decisions take weeks, not days
 



 • Keeping the CRM clean so nothing slips
 



 • Feeding lead quality insights back to the marketing side
 



  





 What we're looking for:
 



 • Excellent spoken English and Hindi — phone presence matters more than your resume here
 



 • 1–3 years in inside sales, pre\-sales, or client servicing; interiors, real estate or luxury retail is a strong plus
 



 • Genuinely consultative — able to ask good questions and listen, not push
 



 • Organised enough to follow up on time, every time
 



 • A quiet space to take calls from, a reliable connection, and the discipline to work without someone watching
 



  





 This role is fully remote. Work from anywhere in India — we care about how you handle the calls, not where you sit.
 



  





 How to apply:
 



 Along with your CV, send a 30\-second voice note to \+91 99905 60605 — in English and Hindi — pitching an interior design service to a prospective client. We will only review applications that include the voice note.
 



  





 Harsh Bhardwaj \| Founder, 403Labs

This role combines deep technical expertise, solution architecture to enable GenAI\-led transformation across the SDLC and business workflows.

 IN\_ Manager\_ Agentic AI/ GenAI Architect \_AppTech\_Advisory\_ Kolkata (Immediate joiners)

**Technical Leadership \& Delivery**

* Review architecture, code, prompt design, RAG pipeline design, data model, API design, and integration approaches.
* Ensure quality, performance, security, maintainability, observability, cost efficiency, and production readiness.


 Advanced RAG, Semantic Search \& Knowledge Architecture
   

  

* Design and optimize RAG pipelines including ingestion, chunking, metadata extraction, embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, citation generation, and answer synthesis.
* Implement semantic search across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured knowledge sources.
* Integrate with enterprise knowledge repositories such as SharePoint, Confluence, S3, Google Drive, databases, ITSM tools, and document management systems.
* Define knowledge freshness, access\-controlled retrieval, lineage, deduplication, feedback loops, and retrieval quality improvement mechanisms.


**Agentic AI \& MCP\-based Tool Integration**
* Design and implement agentic workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
* Implement tool calling, memory, workflow state, human\-in\-the\-loop approval, API actions, and safe execution boundaries.
* Build or guide MCP server implementations for secure agent\-to\-tool and LLM\-to\-enterprise\-system integration.
* Evaluate A2A communication patterns for multi\-agent collaboration, delegation, and hand\-offs where relevant.


**Backend, API, Data \& Event\-Driven Engineering**
* Build scalable services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Java, or similar technologies.
* Design REST APIs and microservices for LLM orchestration, semantic search, ingestion, agent execution, feedback, and evaluation.
* Use SQL and NoSQL databases for application metadata, session history, audit logs, feedback, configurations, and workflow state.
* Design Redis caching patterns for session state, memory, rate limiting, token optimization, retrieval caching, distributed locks, and workflow continuity.
* Design asynchronous workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Google Pub/Sub, or equivalent, including retry, DLQ, idempotency, ordering, and schema management.


**Evaluation, Observability, Security \& Governance**
* Implement LLM tracing, prompt/version tracking, token usage monitoring, latency tracking, cost monitoring, and feedback analytics.
* Define evaluation datasets and metrics for faithfulness, groundedness, answer relevance, context relevance, hallucination rate, toxicity, latency, and cost.
* Use LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS, DeepEval, TruLens, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent.
* Implement guardrails against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, toxic responses, and privacy violations.
* Support AI\-assisted SDLC adoption using GitHub Copilot, Codex, CursorAI, Claude Code, Cline, or similar tools.


**Mandatory skill sets:**
 Enterprise GenAI Architecture \- Reference architecture, platform strategy, reusable accelerators, NFRs, governance
   

  

 RAG \& Semantic Search \- Hybrid search, BM25, vector DBs, embeddings, re\-ranking, citations, grounding
   

  

 Agentic AI \- LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, planning, memory, human\-in\-loop
   

  

 MCP \& A2A \- MCP servers/gateways, tool ecosystem, secure execution, A2A multi\-agent patterns
   

  

 Backend API \- Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Java, REST, microservices, OpenAPI, API gateways
   

  

 Observability \- LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent.
   

  

 Data Architecture \- SQL, NoSQL, vector DB, object storage, analytics stores, metadata, lineage, audit
   

  

 Caching \- Redis, session continuity, memory, rate limiting, distributed locks, retrieval caching
   

  

 Messaging \- Kafka, event\-driven design, RabbitMQ, DLQ, retry, idempotency, event schemas, async workflows
   

  

 Cloud \& Model Strategy \- Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Hugging Face, SLMs
   

  

 LLMOps / MLOps / DevOps \- Prompt/model versioning, evaluation gates, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Chart, Terraform
   

  

 Security \& Responsible AI – Guardrails, prompt injection, LLM Shield, PII, privacy, compliance, audit, model risk management
   

  

**Preferred Skills:**
 Relevant Certifications preferred.
   

  

**Years of experience required:**
 9\+ years (with exposure GenAI/LLM ecosystems)
   

  

**Education qualification:**
 B.E. / B.Tech / MCA/ M.E/ M.TECH/ MBA/ PGDM. All qualifications should be in regular full\-time mode with no extension of course duration due to backlogs.

ba13fbf6.description:
**Summary** 




 The Technical Bid Manager is the Bid Management subject\-matter expert within the EMS core bid team, responsible for converting customer RFQs into compliant, costed, and executable solutions. The role owns end\-to\-end bid governance, including RFQ intake, requirements traceability, compliance management, proposal development, review governance, pricing approvals, and final bid submission. Working closely with customers, engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, finance, and supplier teams, the Technical Bid Manager ensures all proposal commitments are technically feasible, commercially viable, and ready for successful transition into NPI and execution. The position requires strong leadership, structured problem\-solving, commercial awareness, customer\-facing communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent bids while driving decision\-making through evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end technical bid governance, ensuring bid readiness from RFQ receipt through final submission and management approval.
* Lead RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability to ensure customer requirements are fully captured and addressed.
* Establish proposal architecture, bid strategy, solution storytelling, and executive\-level presentations to communicate compelling customer solutions.
* Drive go/no\-go decisions, pricing gate reviews, approval milestones, and bid governance reviews, ensuring risks, assumptions, and deviations are visible to decision\-makers.
* Manage proposal review cycles, including Red Team and Gold Team reviews, and ensure timely closure of all review actions.
* Coordinate and prioritize resources across multiple concurrent bid opportunities while maintaining bid quality and submission timelines.
* Review customer RFQs, drawings, specifications, BOMs, standards, and technical data packages to identify gaps, risks, assumptions, and clarification needs.
* Develop structured customer clarification logs and convert incomplete requirements into documented assumptions, dependencies, closure plans, and executable solutions.
* Define solution approaches, basis of estimate, implementation strategies, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Prepare auditable technical evidence, compliance documentation, proposal narratives, management approval packages, and supporting bid artifacts.
* Develop resource plans, cycle\-time estimates, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capital expenditure estimates, implementation schedules, and milestone plans.
* Lead integrated planning activities, RAID management, change control processes, and configuration governance throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Ensure alignment and consistency across engineering, manufacturing, process, test, quality, automation, supply chain, sourcing, and finance inputs.
* Support supplier evaluations, quotation reviews, make\-versus\-buy analyses, and recommendation development based on technical and commercial considerations.
* Facilitate customer clarification meetings, supplier reviews, equipment trials, workshops, and program reviews as required.
* Define acceptance criteria, validation approaches, handover requirements, and key deliverables to support transition into NPI and program execution.
* Maintain controlled bid templates, estimation databases, lessons learned repositories, and reusable proposal content.
* Comply with organizational information security, confidentiality, quality management, and document control requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with global customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
* Escalate risks proactively and ensure timely resolution of issues that may impact proposal quality, cost, schedule, or compliance.



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* Expertise in RFQ decomposition, bid governance, requirements traceability, compliance management, and proposal development.
* Strong knowledge of technical bid management methodologies, gated review processes, and proposal lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in developing compliance matrices, risk registers, action trackers, requirements traceability registers, and governance documentation.
* Experience creating technical proposals, executive presentations, customer\-facing solution narratives, and management approval packages.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to evaluate cost, schedule, risk, contract deliverables, and business impacts.
* Knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI processes, EMS operations, process engineering, quality systems, test strategies, and supply chain considerations.
* Ability to develop resource loading models, cycle\-time calculations, capacity assessments, equipment requirements, tooling estimates, implementation schedules, and capital investment evaluations.
* Experience with ERP, PLM, document management repositories, BOM management systems, and controlled content environments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Project, and equivalent planning and project management tools.
* Understanding of change control, configuration management, estimation methodologies, technical documentation, and proposal costing principles.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to make evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and customer presentation skills.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, and supplier organizations.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids, work under fixed deadlines, and maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Industrial or a related engineering discipline. PMP and/or MBA is preferred.

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Cloud Platform Architect, a typical day involves designing and developing cloud native architectures that support scalable and resilient applications. This includes working with various architectural patterns such as two\-tier, three\-tier, and serverless models. The role requires building and managing applications using containers, microservices, immutable infrastructure, and declarative application programming interfaces. * Lead the evaluation and adoption of new cloud technologies and tools to enhance architectural capabilities.
* Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Ensure architectural compliance with organizational standards and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between technical teams and stakeholders to align project goals.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:

* Experience with immutable infrastructure concepts and declarative APIs.

aa909667.title: Applied AI Architect
aa909667.description:
**About Anthropic**
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia\-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer\-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
   

  

 Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams \& stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering \& development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

23f72b2b.description:
At AT DAWN Technologies, we are a fast\-growing technology services company building high\-impact teams across Data Engineering, AI, and Backend Development. Our clients include some of the most innovative product companies in the world. We operate delivery centers in India and Vietnam, enabling rapid, high\-quality execution with a product mindset.
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Enterprise Solution Architect** 
 with expertise in
 **High** 
**Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux\-based environments** 
 to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise\-grade container orchestration platform.
 



  





 We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer\-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.
 


* Leadership and Strategy:
* Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
* Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.
* Identify the potential challenges and constraints that impact the solution and project plan.
* Opportunity assessment:
* Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof\-of\-concept engagements to a successful conclusion
* Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.
* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show \& Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.
* Customer\-centric mindset:
* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Team Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.



**Required Skills:** 



* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components



 such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.
 


* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high\-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification \- CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.
* Typically, 6\-8 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform projects.

e567013e.title: SOLUTION ARCHITECT - FI/CO (Finance / Controlling)
e567013e.description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





  





  





 The solution architect is a key role, which safeguards and develops the design of the template/solution, has deep understanding \& analysis of the business processes, to enable and steer optimal, scalable and holistic functional solution architecture and design which includes both new and legacy technology landscape.
 



  





 The role leverages strong leadership capabilities to work with key \& senior business and digital stakeholders collaborate across domains where needed and influences discussions towards evolving a simpler technology landscape which enables business outcomes and business value at speed.
 



  





 Keeping up to date with the latest developments in the respective functional and technology area is key success criteria for this role.
 



  





 You appreciate the mix of strategic thinking and turning architecture trends and requirements into practice. You get motivated to keep learning and to forget the obsolete and to work agile and being open to the change. In addition, you are energized by working both independently and interdependently and cross functions. Last but not least you share and live the IKEA culture and values.
 



  





 For this role we believe you have, solid SAP S/4 Finance experience. Experience of the R2R – Record to Report process is critical to the role. Experience of delivering multi country implementations of SAP products and SAP S4/HANA platform as a solution architect. Have exposure to technologies beyond SAP and not be limited by platform in devising the technology stack strategy. Have strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to convince the leadership in Finance organization, country Leadership and Enterprise architects.
 



  





 Acts as a positive force to bring out the best in people. Must lead by example in line with IKEA values and leadership compass. Is a strategic thinker with strong foundations \& proficiency in content in either or both functional or technology area, proven delivery capabilities in leading in the SAP technology/platform.
 



  





 You have experience in the following areas:
 



  




* 20\+ years of experience in building Finance technology roadmap and solutions with relevant experience in providing the same in Retail Domain
* Proven experience in evangelizing organizations with outside in technology knowledge which is practical and relevant to the business processes and the tactical and strategic objectives of the business
* Proven experience in working with business stakeholders and advising/influencing business strategy roadmap by leveraging knowledge in the relevant insights and developments in technology capabilities
* Deep knowledge of the changing landscape and new products impacting finance processes
* Experience in drafting 3\-year and 5\-year roadmaps for digital organizations in the relevant technology area in SAP Finance. Knowledge of other ERP capabilities is an added advantage.
* Building strong relationships with stakeholders
* Track record of delivering successful projects, managing and maintaining the integrity of established SAP templates, navigating complex situations, influencing senior stakeholders with the relevant information, insights.
* Strong communication skills, verbal, written and presentation.
* Demonstrable critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Good knowledge of SAP platform architecture/engineering across multiple modules and technology domains
* Strong understanding of processes, application of the same and trends in SAP technology/platforms
* Experience in building business case for multi\-year programs and getting consensus from CXO organization.



  





  





  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





  





 A solution architect is a key leadership role who has deep expertise in the business processes and their solution implementation in the respective functional area. A Solution Architect must have strong leadership capabilities, balance functional and technical acumen with effective
 



  





 communication, strategic thinking, and adaptability to steer the relevant optimal solution implementations as well as safeguard the sanctity of the design.
 



  





 This role involves continuous learning and evolution to keep up with the ever\-changing technology landscape and business needs.
 



  





 Your responsibilities are:
 



  





 Summary
 


* Understand/Analyses the Technology and Business Process landscape to develop relevant insights. Leverages deep expertise in the respective Functional/Technology area to develop, steer optimal solutions that are holistic and scalable, that simplify the technology landscape and enable agility in enabling/unlocking business value and potentially pivot the business case positively.
* Uses strong leadership capabilities combined with effective communication to build strong network and relationships within the business and technology stakeholders.
* Is passionate about keeping up to date with current developments and industry best practices in the relevant functional and technology area.
* Exhibits strong accountability/ownership, is proactive, is resourceful and able to navigate and influence/pivot discussions, using logic, expertise, insights and data.



  





 Technical/Functional Expertise:
 


* Possess a deep understanding of business processes in the retail industry and their implementation in the relevant technology platform, functional modules, coupled with strong leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, business process analysis and optimization, stakeholder management, and complex ecosystem familiarity.
* Understand and analyze the technology, functional and business process landscape, interfaces.
* Work with business process owners, technology architects to design \& architect simple, scalable and effective solutions considering integration, data flows, and functional modules which will help secure a strong solution foundation in the relevant technology/area.
* Works with Functional teams to analyze requirements, cross functional, cross solution and cross domain impact. Ensures conceptual designs/blueprints are holistic and effectively documented.
* Own product backlog and prioritize the releases along with process owners.
* Co\-leads \& participates in workshops for clarifying requirements and arriving at confirmed scope. Participates in the relevant cross functional/domain meetings for analyzing and communicating impact
* Provides inputs and builds solutions that could positively pivot business case.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the project lifecycle. Collaborates with development and project/program teams to design and implement enhancements, and interfaces, ensuring compliance with best practices and standards.
* Participates in Release management gates and provides go/no\-go from solution perspective (scalability, performance, invasiveness, integration, design, etc.). Ensure that the solution complies with industry\-specific regulations and organizational compliance policies.



  





 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management:
 


* Brings strong collaborations across the organization, builds a strong network and relationships within the business and technology stakeholders, is able to navigate within and across organization.
* Staying up to date with the latest technologies, trends, and industry best. You will continuously evaluate and incorporate new methodologies, tools, and frameworks to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the technology/platform. Builds effective partnerships with Suppliers for gaining insights, leveraging and improving solution direction.
* Exhibits strong accountability/ownership, rigor and a “can do” mindset.
* Builds and communicates solution vision effectively, drives clarity while simplifying the objectives, is proactive, is resourceful and Influences/pivots discussions, using logic, expertise, insights and data.
* Positively influences the team.



  





 Supplier:
 


* Works with industry partners and suppliers and technology architects to continuously investigate and bring in best of breed solutions to improve and develop a future\-enabled solution landscape.
* Is passionate about keeping up to date with current developments and industry best practices in the relevant functional and technology area and leverages connects with suppliers towards this objective



  





 Problem\-Solving and Decision\-Making:
 


* Analyzing complex issues and identifying creative and effective solutions, leveraging and weighing existing solutions, a holistic perspective of the problem statements and solutions and where appropriate build/reuse existing solutions \& capabilities
* Making well\-informed decisions based on data, insights, and stakeholder input.
* Handling crises and high\-pressure situations with composure and sound judgment. Encouraging a culture of problem\-solving and innovation within the team.



  





  





  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





  





  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

f568fae4.title: Technical Program Manager - Bid Management
f568fae4.description:
**About the Business:**




  





 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
 



  





**Responsibilities:**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical bid governance from RFQ receipt through management approval and final submission readiness.
* Own technical solution architecture and ensure alignment across NPI, process engineering, manufacturing, test, automation, quality, supply chain, and operations functions.
* Develop compelling technical narratives, win themes, solution strategies, and executive\-level presentations to support customer proposals and management reviews.
* Lead go/no\-go decisions, pricing reviews, approval gates, and management decision forums, ensuring risks, assumptions, and deviations are clearly communicated.
* Manage bid priorities, resource allocation, and execution across multiple concurrent opportunities while maintaining quality and schedule commitments.
* Review RFQs, customer specifications, drawings, BOMs, technical data packages, and standards to identify gaps, risks, and clarification requirements.
* Develop structured customer clarification logs and convert incomplete requirements into documented assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and closure actions.



  





**Essential Attributes:**



* RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability management.
* Bid strategy development, solution storytelling, executive communication, and customer\-facing proposal presentations.
* Proposal governance, gated review processes, Red Team and Gold Team reviews, and approval gate management.
* Technical solution architecture and cross\-functional integration across NPI, manufacturing process, test engineering, automation, quality, and supply chain domains.
* Integrated planning, RAID management, risk mitigation, change management, and configuration control.
* Commercial understanding of cost models, schedules, capital investments, risks, contractual obligations, and business case development.
* Development of resource loading models, cycle\-time calculations, capacity planning, equipment sizing, tooling requirements, implementation schedules, and cost estimates.
* Supplier evaluation, quotation analysis, make\-versus\-buy assessments, and technical recommendation development.



  





**Qualifications:**



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* PMP certification and/or MBA preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level:**



* 10\-15 years of experience in bid management, technical program management, NPI, manufacturing industrialization, engineering, or related functions within EMS or complex product manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience supporting customer RFQs, technical proposals, manufacturing industrialization programs, and cross\-functional solution development.
* Proven track record of leading multidisciplinary teams and providing evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
* Ability to work effectively with global customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
* Willingness to travel for customer workshops, supplier reviews, equipment trials, and program reviews as required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer\-facing presentation capabilities.
