fa27fa91.description:
**\*\*Company Description\*\*
 



  





 Visco is a facility management SaaS platform built for schools and colleges. It helps educational institutions streamline the operations behind running a campus — from maintenance and asset tracking to space utilization, vendor coordination, and compliance — replacing manual, fragmented processes with a single, data\-driven system. Visco is committed to helping institutions run smoother, safer, and more efficient campuses, so administrators can focus less on operational firefighting and more on students and staff.
 



  





 \*\*Role Description\*\*
 



  





 The B2B SaaS Solutions Expert – Schools \& Colleges is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram. This role focuses on introducing Visco's facility management platform to educational institutions and guiding them through effective adoption and integration. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting discovery conversations with school and college stakeholders (facilities heads, administrators, procurement), mapping their operational needs to platform capabilities, and designing tailored solution packages. The role involves giving product demos, preparing proposals, coordinating pilots, and supporting implementation across facilities, admin, and maintenance teams. The B2B SaaS Solutions Expert also collaborates with product and operations teams to share feedback, improve offerings, and build long\-term partnerships with institutions.
 



  





 \*\*Qualifications\*\*
 



  





 \- Strong experience in B2B SaaS solutioning or consultative sales for schools, colleges, or education\-focused products.
 



 \- Ability to understand institutional operational needs and translate them into clear product configurations, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.
 



 \- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills for interacting with school administrators, facilities managers, and procurement teams.
 



 \- Comfort with technology platforms, data\-driven decision making, and working closely with product and tech teams.
 



 \- Background in facilities management, campus operations, or education administration is preferred; prior work with school infrastructure or operations projects is an advantage.
 



 \- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline; postgraduate qualifications or certifications in operations, facilities management, or business are a plus.
 



 \- Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, manage onsite meetings and workshops, and travel to partner schools and colleges as needed.
 



 \- Demonstrated attention to detail, reliability, and professionalism when handling institutional operations and vendor relationships.**

 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

 UKG Ready is an exciting product of Ultimate Kronos Group which continues to experience incredible growth!  We hire people having knowledge in Human Capital Management or Workforce Management domain for products like ADP, Ceridian Dayforce, Oracle HCM, PeopleSoft, People Strong, Ramco, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday.

* Leverage your knowledge and experience to consult on best practices and assist clients (directly or through some onsite person) in designing and building a solution that meets their needs
* Utilize your technical aptitude to re\-configure our software solution and solve very complex issues
* Stay up\-to\-date on the latest product features and functionality
* Act as the subject matter expert in the product area
* Understand \& explain clearly difficult \&/or sensitive information, and work collaboratively to build consensus
* Contribute to team objectives that may have impact on the area/group
* Work cross\-functionally and amongst a team on new client implementation, upgrade, and change order projects
* Drive consistency into UKG Ready delivery practices by leveraging their implementation experience to define processes and best practices for the services organization
* Provide significant transfer of UKG Ready product knowledge to UKG customers
* Be ready to become key point\-of\-contact to UKG Ready stakeholders

 Individuals looking to be a part of our talented team should possess the following:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or related field
* At least 8\+ years of industry work experience with exposure to Global implementations
* Extensive domain experience in implementing HCM or WFM software.
* Proven knowledge of SDLC \& AGILE methodologies
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced team environment
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and changing environments
* Excellent communication and consulting skills
* Ability to work in a business required shift (3:00 PM IST to 12:00 AM IST)


**Company Overview**
 UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.
   

  

 UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.
   

  

 Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process

**Your qualifications, your influence** 



  


*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills* 



  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience

* 4\+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning \& Analysis or Sales Performance Management

* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results\-oriented, motivated, self\-starter

* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll\-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  


  


  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion** 

**and Belonging** 



  


 Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 


  


 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
 


  


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 



  


 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 


  


 Anaplan does not:
 


  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.

Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

d2792d42.description:
**Solutions Architect (SA)** 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Remote
 **Experience:** 
 8–12 Years
 



**Work Hours:** 
 EST Time Zone – 2PM to 10PM IST
 



  





**About Us** 




 Lucidity is a rapidly growing company with a first\-of\-its\-kind and impactful product in cloud storage. Joining Lucidity offers the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technology, solve real\-world problems for major enterprises, and be part of a company that is reshaping the future of cloud storage.
 


* We were awarded Best Infra and Dev Tools SaaS Startup by SaaSBoomi –
 
 Link
* Listed among India's Top Startups by LinkedIn –
 
 Link
* Backed by $32M in funding from investors like Alpha Wave Global, WestBridge Capital, and Beenext –
 
 Link
* Category leader in cloud storage optimization
* Trusted by major enterprises, including Fortune 500 companies spanning the US and UK, our major markets
* Opportunity to work with experienced co\-founders
 
 Vatsal
 
 \&
 
 Nitin
 
 \- serial entrepreneurs with over a decade of experience at companies like Microsoft, Swiggy, and Tracxn, building and selling large tech products
* Work in a deep\-tech company and be part of an accelerated growth journey
* Presence across India, Abu Dhabi, the US, and the UK



  





**What We Do** 




 Lucidity is a company that provides an automated NoOps disk auto\-scaler for cloud storage across AWS, Azure, and GCP. It addresses over\-provisioned block storage by dynamically scaling capacity, increasing disk utilization to around 80% from 25–35%. This results in cost reductions of up to 70% for businesses. Here's a
 
 video
 
 of what Lucidity does.
 



 Key benefits include:
 


* Significant cost savings on storage (especially EBS costs)
* Elimination of downtime by preventing disk space issues
* Reduced DevOps effort through automation
* Application\-agnostic solution that works with various systems



 Additional links:
 
 Website
 
 \|
 
 Blog
 
 \|
 
 YouTube
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 




 We are growing aggressively and plan to expand our revenue by 5x in the next year. We are passionate about creating something unique, innovative, and big from India for global customers.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 who can operate as the single technical owner for our most complex, high\-value enterprise accounts \- someone who needs minimal direction to take a customer from technical evaluation through large\-scale production rollout. This is not a role for someone who executes a playbook; it's for someone who can build the playbook, defend it in front of a customer's CTO, and adapt it on the fly when the environment doesn't cooperate.
 



 You'll be the senior\-most technical voice in the room for enterprise accounts \- trusted to make architectural calls independently, to push back on both customers and internal teams when the easy answer isn't the right one, and to represent Lucidity credibly to VP\- and C\-level technical stakeholders.
 


* Independently own end\-to\-end technical architecture and solution design for Lucidity's largest and most complex enterprise engagements, across multi\-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments \- with minimal oversight from leadership.
* Act as the primary technical decision\-maker for your accounts: designing scalable, secure, production\-grade deployments and de\-risking rollouts for the world's largest enterprises without needing hand\-holding.
* Lead technical discovery and solutioning conversations directly with senior customer stakeholders (VP Engineering, CTO, Head of Infrastructure), translating business and operational challenges into concrete technical architecture and a credible path to value.
* Serve as a trusted advisor \- not just answering "how do I deploy this," but shaping how large enterprises think about cloud storage cost, resilience, and operational efficiency as part of their broader cloud strategy.
* Own customer relationships end\-to\-end for your book of accounts: driving time\-to\-value, managing technical risk, and being personally accountable for CSAT and renewal health.
* Anticipate and resolve escalations before they become critical \- you're the person other team members loop in when a deployment gets hard, not the person who escalates upward.
* Mentor and technically guide junior Solutions Engineers/Consultants, review their architecture decisions, and help raise the technical bar of the broader post\-sales team.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering, feeding back field insights from the most demanding customers to influence roadmap and product hardening.
* Represent Lucidity externally \- presenting at events, running enterprise workshops, and contributing to whitepapers/blogs that establish technical thought leadership.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to close out critical technical milestones.



**Must Haves** 



* **8–12 years** 
 of professional experience architecting and operating solutions on cloud infrastructure, with a track record of owning complex technical engagements independently, start to finish.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across AWS and Azure (GCP a plus) \- compute, storage, networking, security, IAM, and automation/IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience as a senior technical lead in a post\-sales, professional services, or solutions consulting capacity for enterprise/Fortune 500 customers.
* Proven ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy \- comfortable owning ambiguous, high\-stakes technical problems without a playbook, and making the call.
* Strong executive presence \- able to run a room with CTOs and VP Engineering stakeholders and hold the technical narrative under pressure.
* Working experience across Windows and Linux environments.
* Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers/architects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing technical documentation, whitepapers, or presenting at events.
* Strong account and project management skills \- able to run multiple complex, concurrent enterprise engagements.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites/locations as necessary.
* Public cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in the storage domain is a strong plus.



**What Do We Promise?** 



* A high\-growth work environment
* Autonomy to decide \& deliver on KPIs
* Hybrid / work\-from\-home options \| Flexible hours \| Unlimited leaves

e62e0a7e.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI
e62e0a7e.description:
**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Cloud Solution Architect to serve as a trusted advisor and technical leader for Microsoft's strategic Retail \& Consumer Goods customers.
   

  

 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Azure, AI, Security, Data, Business Applications, Modern Work, and Unified solutions. You will proactively identify customer challenges, translate business requirements into scalable cloud solutions, and drive adoption, consumption, usage, and expansion opportunities across the Microsoft platform.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical expertise, strong executive communication skills, customer\-centric leadership, and the ability to lead virtual teams across Microsoft, partner organizations, and customer stakeholders. The Cloud Solution Architect serves as both a customer advocate and a transformation leader, helping organizations modernize their technology estate while accelerating business value realization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Business Impact
   

  

 Proactively identifies and anticipates new cross\-solution opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation. Strategically consults with, actively listens to, and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements. Identifies, anticipates, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps both existing and novel architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes. Proactively anticipates and captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.
   

  

 Anticipates, identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption for complex customers/scenarios. Proactively applies broad business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.
   

  

 Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking). Orchestrates and collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on\-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction. Proactively anticipates and manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures. Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.
   

  

 Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., product offerings such as value\-based deliverables \[VBDs], advice, training, technical validation), ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed to prepare complex customers for operational readiness and achievement of their business goals and targets. Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long\-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage. Guides complex customers/partners towards a well\-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence \[AI]\-enabled), and cost\- and performance\-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities. Articulates the value of Unified and supports sellers, partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with appropriate services. Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

 Proactively identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, creates or improves an existing business model, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product \[MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings. Proactively helps the customer/partner accelerate their adoption and use of Microsoft product/platform strategy\-aligned (cross\-solution area) solutions. Builds relationships with, and provides direction to technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C\-suite level, and builds the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs). Leads and elevates interactions as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Office (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), and other C\-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.
   

  

 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies and aggregates patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries, and leverages them with relevant industry perspective to develop strategic and actionable insights. Presents business cases to program managers to advocate for and influence product roadmaps, decision making, and bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Drives the realization of customer/partner conditions of success by leveraging an understanding of customer goals. Anticipates, addresses, and leads customer confidence calls to resolve customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and creates and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.
   

  

 Partner Specialization
   

  

 Identifies and directs attention to multiple, strategic opportunities (e.g., launch deals) that align with revenue goals, and orchestrates growth of solution utilization pipeline with partners. Leads assistance with partner and sales teams to bring clarity to specific, complex opportunities through proof of concept and technical pre\-sales support.
   

  

 Understands and anticipates solution area\-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and proactively leads initiatives to address them by supporting, assembling, and leading a v\-team. Influences, challenges, and supports partners in developing scalable offerings, practices, products, and solutions, and investing and adopting new technologies at scale of the customer. May maintain relationships with non\-technical senior stakeholders (e.g., sales) within the partner to understand their business model. Maintains active visibility in solution area\-specific communities both to build credibility in internal/partner work and information sharing (e.g., technical updates, public facing roadmap) and to influence partners. Collaborates with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineering, sales) to provide field\-based insights related to products/solutions related to functioning, pricing, implementation, and other areas.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up\-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand. eecf60ad.title: Engagement Manager- GCC
eecf60ad.description:
**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 Own the successful execution of GCC engagements from mobilization through stabilization and scale. Serve as the primary operating interface between the client and company, bringing together talent, delivery, HR, operations, finance, technology, and governance teams to deliver against client commitments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Client \& Engagement Leadership** 



* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day engagement leader for assigned GCC clients.
* Translate client objectives into clear execution plans, milestones, ownership, and operating rhythms.
* Build strong relationships with client delivery teams, functional leaders, HR, procurement, and operating teams.
* Anticipate issues and bring solutions to the client before they become escalations.
* Conduct regular executive and operational governance reviews.



  





**GCC Mobilization** 



* Lead new GCC engagements from SOW signature through launch and stabilization.
* Own integrated plans covering hiring, onboarding, infrastructure, IT, security, facilities, training, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate dependencies across client and internal teams and drive readiness against agreed launch dates.
* Establish governance, reporting, SLAs, KPIs, escalation paths, and decision rights.



  





**Talent \& Workforce Delivery** 



* Partner with recruiting and delivery teams to meet hiring plans by role, skill, location, and start date.
* Track candidate pipeline, selection ratios, offers, joining rates, attrition, and backfills.
* Identify hiring risks early and drive corrective actions.
* Work with HR and business teams on onboarding, employee experience, retention, and workforce planning.



  





**Operational Governance** 



* Own engagement scorecards across headcount, hiring, milestones, SLA/KPI performance, attrition, financial performance, client satisfaction, risks, and dependencies.
* Run weekly operating reviews and monthly executive governance.
* Maintain clear RAID logs with owners and closure dates.
* Translate contractual commitments into operational execution.



  





**Commercial \& Financial Management** 



* Understand the SOW, pricing model, assumptions, and commercial commitments.
* Track revenue, cost, utilization, margin, and headcount against plan.
* Identify scope changes and work with commercial teams on change orders.
* Protect both client outcomes and engagement economics.



  





**Scale \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to expand existing GCC engagements into additional functions, capabilities, and locations.
* Help clients move from initial staffing toward sustainable operating capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, productivity, training, and AI adoption.
* Capture lessons learned and establish repeatable practices across GCC engagements.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* GCC launches happen against committed timelines.
* Hiring and onboarding plans remain on track.
* Client executives and sales team have clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.
* Issues are identified and resolved before they become escalations.
* Engagement economics remain within agreed targets.
* Client confidence increases as the GCC scales.
* Initial engagements expand into broader, long\-term client relationships.



  





**Experience** 



* 10\+ years of experience in engagement management, program management, operations, managed services, GCCs, shared services, or technology services.
* Experience managing complex client engagements involving multiple functions and senior stakeholders.
* Experience establishing or scaling India\-based delivery teams strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of workforce mobilization, recruiting, onboarding, governance, and operational delivery.
* Experience managing commercial metrics and engagement financials.
* Prior experience with GCC, BOT, managed capacity, shared services, or captive\-center environments preferred.



  





**Leadership Profile** 



* Takes ownership rather than waits for direction.
* Is comfortable working directly with senior client executives.
* Can move between executive conversations and detailed execution.
* Creates structure in ambiguous situations.
* Makes decisions and drives accountability across teams.
* Communicates clearly, concisely, and early.
* Understands that successful GCC execution requires balancing client experience, people, delivery, and commercial performance.

* Experience in developing and managing cross functional partnership as well as client relationships in complex and rapidly evolving environment
* Experience operating effectively in an ambiguous and unstructured environment to rapidly upskill, prioritize and deliver outcomes

 Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. 6bf842a9.title: Lead Technology Program Manager
6bf842a9.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Lead Technology Program Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Program Planning and Execution
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership

* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.

 Risk and Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.


 Customer and Business Alignment
   

  

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business\-critical programs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
* Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
* Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.

* Works cross\-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Sales, Field Service, Warranty, and Customers to ensure successful launch \& completion of retro fitment.
* Coordinate with Regional Service \& Warranty leaders to ensure timely completion of retrofit activities.


**Roles \&** 
**Responsibilities**
* Retro fitment Program Strategy \& Development
* Develop, implement, and manage retrofit programs for the installed base across all product lines.
* Define program scope, deployment strategy, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements.
* Prepare business cases and white papers for management approval, including retrofit budgets and implementation plans.
* Responsible to maintain complete database of the existing Population of all our product lines.
* Program Execution:
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of retrofit programs from concept through deployment.
* Review FMI Document and work with Safety team for HIRA assessment prior to implementation.
* Collaborate with Field Service teams to develop deployment plans and ensure successful retrofit execution at customer sites.
* Develop deployment methodologies, technical documentation, training materials, and service procedures.
* Work with Engg. /PED/Sourcing team for special tool development/procurement related to retro fitment programs

* Periodically Review \& update the forecast order in system based on the actual orders.
* Receive \& Process retro fitment order request from FSE’s and ensure demand creation in ERP.
* Coordinate with SCM and Operations teams to ensure on\-time material availability and order fulfilment.
* Responsible to have full control on customer return material (MCO orders).
* Customer Engagement:
* Act as the primary contact for strategic customers regarding retrofit initiatives.
* Publish Weekly/Monthly Retrofit completion Dashboards to Internal Management \& Customers (RDSO \& Private Car builders)
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout program execution.
* Safety, Quality, and Compliance:
* Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organization’s strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure all field deployment activities comply with applicable EHS requirements.


**Key KPIs:**
* Retrofit HIRA Compliance (%): HIRA completed before deployment (Target – 100%)
* Retrofit Completion Rate %: Commitment \- As per Program Plan \& Target \- \>95%
* Dashboard Reporting Compliance: Commitment – 95% \& Target – 100%


**Education/Training**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering


**Professional** 
**Experience**
* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience.


**Languages**
* English \& Hindi \& Tamil


**Additional Information**
**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**
 At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. 2e0fa61f.description:
About This Role
**8 to 11 years of experience**  

**Skills: Java, Spring boot, Apache Kafka, AWS, Lambda, MongoDB, CI/CD Pipelines**

**About the Role**
------------------


We are migrating a portfolio of on\-premise applications — many of which depend on Java Spring Boot services, on\-prem Apache Kafka clusters for event streaming, and inter\-service messaging — to Amazon Web Services. We need an experienced engineer who has done this end\-to\-end before: assessing applications, untangling on\-prem dependencies, re\-platforming to AWS\-managed services where it makes sense (and lifting\-and\-shifting where it doesn't), cutting over with zero data loss, and leaving behind a clean, observable, cost\-efficient footprint.


You will own technical migration of multiple Spring Boot services from discovery through stabilization, partnering with the application teams who built them and the platform team that runs AWS.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Assessment \& Planning**


* Inventory in\-scope Java / Spring Boot applications and their Kafka topics, consumer groups, and partitioning patterns.
* Map on\-prem dependencies (databases, file shares, schedulers, secrets stores, AD/Kerberos) to AWS equivalents or hybrid solutions.
* Define cutover strategy per service.

**Application Re\-platforming**


* Upgrade Spring Boot applications to versions compatible with AWS SDKs and current Java, modernizing deprecated APIs.
* Replace on\-prem auth (LDAP, Kerberos, mTLS with internal CAs) with AWS IAM, IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA), auth for RDS/DocumentDB/MSK, and AWS Certificate Manager.
* Containerize services (Docker, multi\-stage builds, distroless / Amazon Corretto base images) and deploy via Amazon EKS, ECS Fargate, App Runner, or AWS Lambda — selecting the right runtime per workload.
* Implement health checks, graceful shutdown, JVM tuning for containerized environments (\-XX:MaxRAMPercentage, G1/ZGC selection, JFR), and right\-size compute.

**Kafka Migration**


* Migrate on\-prem Kafka workloads to Amazon MSK (provisioned or Serverless).
* Design topic replication and cutover using MirrorMaker 2, MSK Replicator, or Confluent Replicator; handle offset translation and consumer\-group cutover.
* Re\-architect security: from SASL/PLAIN \+ on\-prem ACLs to SASL/SCRAM in Secrets Manager, mTLS via ACM Private CA, or IAM authentication for MSK; topic ACLs / Kafka quotas as code.
* Tune producer/consumer clients (acks, linger.ms, batch.size, max.poll.records, enable.idempotence, transactional producers) for AWS network characteristics.

**Data \& State Migration**


* Migrate relational data using AWS DMS (full load \+ CDC) to RDS/Aurora; document datastores to DocumentDB or MongoDB Atlas on AWS; caches to ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey / Memcached).
* Validate row counts, checksums, and business\-key parity post\-migration.
* Coordinate dual\-write windows / outbox\-pattern when Kafka and the source DB are migrated in different waves.

**Infrastructure as Code \& CI/CD**


* Provision all AWS resources via AWS CDK (Java / TypeScript), following team standards.
* Build CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

**Observability \& SRE**


* Wire Micrometer; structured JSON logging to CloudWatch Logs or OpenSearch; distributed tracing via AWS X\-Ray or OpenTelemetry.
* Build Grafana / CloudWatch dashboards and alarms for JVM, Kafka lag, error budgets, and cost.
* Author runbooks, SLOs, on\-call playbooks, and post\-migration retrospectives.

**Security, Compliance \& Cost**


* Apply least\-privilege IAM, VPC Endpoints (PrivateLink), security groups, WAF, GuardDuty, and findings remediation.
* Encrypt data at rest (KMS with CMK rotation) and in transit (TLS 1\.2\+); manage secrets in Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.
* Optimize cost: right\-sizing, Savings Plans / Reserved Instances, Graviton migration (r8g / m7g / c7g), S3 storage classes, log retention policies, and idle\-resource teardown.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 8\+ years of experience building production back\-end systems in Java; 5\+ years with Spring Boot (2\.x and 3\.x), Spring Data, Spring Security.


* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Apache Kafka as both producer and consumer, including topic design, partitioning, consumer groups, exactly\-once semantics, schema evolution, and ops (rebalances, ISR, broker tuning).


* 3\+ years of substantive AWS delivery experience — not just experiments; production workloads you can describe.


At least one prior on\-prem* AWS migration of multiple services that you owned end\-to\-end, including the Kafka layer.


**AWS Depth**


* Deep working knowledge of: EKS or ECS/Fargate, MSK (or Confluent Cloud on AWS), VPC networking, IAM, RDS/Aurora, S3, Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, CloudWatch, KMS, Route 53, ALB/NLB, CloudFront, API Gateway.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Comfortable reading and writing AWS CLI / boto3 / Java SDK v2\.

**Java / Spring / Kafka Depth**


* Modern Java (17 / 21\) — records, pattern matching, virtual threads, JFR\-based diagnosis.
* Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6 migration (Jakarta EE namespace, AOT / native via GraalVM where relevant).
* Spring for Apache Kafka and/or Spring Cloud Stream in production: @KafkaListener, ConcurrentKafkaListenerContainerFactory, custom error handlers, RetryTopicConfiguration, transactional producers.
* Confluent Schema Registry / Avro / Protobuf in CI pipelines (schema\-compatibility checks, registry promotion).
* Performance / latency diagnosis: thread dumps, heap analysis, async\-profiler, JFR.

**Soft Skills**


* Strong written communication — ADRs, runbooks, migration playbooks.
* Comfortable embedding briefly into multiple application teams.
* Pragmatic: knows when to refactor and when to rehost.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD / CKS); AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, DevOps Engineer – Professional, or Advanced Networking – Specialty.
* Experience with hybrid networking (AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN, PrivateLink) and routing between on\-prem data centers and AWS during migration.

c40aa99f.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**5 to 7 years of experience**  

**Skills: Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Python/Bash/PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines**

Role Overview

  

Migrate on\-premises relational databases to AWS using strong database expertise, cloud architecture skills, and AI\-accelerated tooling to deliver secure, reliable, low\-downtime migrations.

  

Key Responsibilities


* Assess on\-prem workloads and plan homogeneous/heterogeneous migrations.

 A strong validation mindset to catch AI\-generated errors (hallucinations, subtle logic bugs). Awareness of downstream AI/ML pipelines, data lakes, and vector databases.

Problem\-solving, clear communication, and project management awareness.

AWS Certified Database \- Specialty or Solutions Architect; enterprise migration experience.


Apply now

43166e08.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re\-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well\-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
   

  

 On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
   

  

 Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
   

  

 Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
   

  

* Strong Consulting, client\-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post\-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
* Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
* hand\-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud\-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event\-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud\-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring


**Additional Desired Skills**
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies
* Database migrations
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks
* Multi\-cloud experience


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 \& s3\)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience in software development
* 3\+ years of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) experience
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C\#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of IT implementation experience
* Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
* Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands\-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience
* Experience with fully automated machine training (automatic re\-training, automatic testing)

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.

You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

* SAC Application Development: Design and deliver KPI\-led stories and analytic applications in live and import modes that drive clear decisions and measurable outcomes.

* Business Objects Reporting: Develop and maintain Universes, reports, and dashboards aligned to enterprise data standards to support robust reporting needs.
* Agile Delivery and Documentation: Operate within agile and scrum frameworks, documenting models, data flows, and application logic for reliable, repeatable delivery.
* Technical Leadership and Coaching: Provide hands\-on leadership, reviews, and mentorship to uplift team capability in SAC, Datasphere, scripting, and analytics guidelines.
* Multi\-Functional Collaboration: Translate business requirements into scalable builds, partnering with Finance, Operations, and technology teams to ensure adoption and value.
* Scripting and Automation: Apply SQL, Python, and JavaScript to build custom widgets, automate data orchestration, and accelerate delivery of analytics products.

--------------------------------

* Overall, 10\-12 years of experience and at least 2\-3 years’ experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a Consultant, Analyst, Developer or relevant role.

* Expertise with SAC predictive functionality, Experienced features (Hard\-working Assist, Inquisitive Predict, Sensible Discovery), advanced story canvases, data blending, cross\-calculations, input controls, and linked analysis.
* Skilled in connecting SAC and Datasphere to varied data sources, including SAP HANA, and external databases.
* Proficiency in SAP Datasphere for building unified, harmonized, and governed data models to serve enterprise analytics.
* In\-depth understanding of data integration and ETL processes across SAC, Datasphere, and other analytics platforms.
* Advanced scripting abilities in SQL, Python, and JavaScript to enable data manipulation and automation within both SAC and Datasphere environments.
* Experience with SAC scripting for creating custom widgets and analytics applications, as well as automating data flows in Datasphere.
* Understanding of SAP related Finance and/or Operations processes will be valued.
* Certification in one or more of the following will be appreciated: SAC Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Low\-Code/No\-Code Developer.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
* Energetic, organised and self\-motivated.
* Fluent in business English.

* Proven track record optimizing performance and scalability across SAC and Datasphere in global environments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP BusinessObjects Universes and enterprise reporting migrations.

f3ba1e61.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Worldwide Physical Security team is looking for a Program Manager to help deliver physical security projects across our international network. Working within the team, you will own the day\-to\-day delivery of assigned projects end\-to\-end. Coordinating with site security teams, vendors and stakeholders to plan work, manage funding and approvals, track delivery and keep projects on time, on budget and to standard. It is a hands\-on delivery role for someone early in their program\-management career who enjoys turning plans into delivered outcomes in a fast\-paced, multi\-site environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of physical security projects across assigned sites and programs — from intake and funding preparation through deployment and handover.
* Support the team's senior program managers on their larger, more complex initiatives — tracking actions, chasing dependencies and helping keep delivery moving.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices and requirements.
* Support capital funding requests and manage the approvals workflow through to sign\-off, tracking spend against approved funding, flagging variances and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Work directly with vendors and installers to schedule works, monitor progress and confirm delivery meets the agreed scope, standards and quality bar.
* Coordinate with site security teams and cross\-functional partners to align on requirements, dependencies and timelines, escalating issues appropriately.
* Track project milestones and risks, driving early resolution or ensuring a clean hand\-off to the right owner, and report accurate status and metrics into regular business reviews.
* Support proof\-of\-concept and pilot activity for new physical security technologies, gathering data and documenting outcomes.
* Ensure solutions are delivered in line with Amazon physical security standards and relevant regulatory, legal and safety requirements.
* Contribute to team process improvements — optimising the templates, trackers and workflows the team relies on to deliver.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing progress across your program and catching up with partners on solutions being validated across the worldwide network. Mid\-morning you join a working session with field security teams and stakeholders to define the problem behind an upcoming initiative and shape the requirements for a pilot, working through how a solution will integrate into live operations without slowing throughput. After lunch, you prepare a capital funding request for a program, pull together data from a recent proof\-of\-concept to strengthen the business case, and update your senior PM on key risks. Later you coordinate with a partner on a deployment timeline and capture the lessons from a completed pilot to inform the next rollout. Throughout it all, you balance careful planning with hands\-on execution, moving solutions from pilot to network\-wide reality.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Worldwide Physical Security Innovation Solutions team develops security solutions across Amazon's network. We start from the problem, understanding our customers and the risks they face. We then develop, validate and scale solutions that remove manual security processes and let the network operate securely and efficiently. We take ideas from proof\-of\-concept through to fully\-realized network\-wide deployment solutions. We partner with field security teams, operations, and technology partners to prove what works and roll it out at scale. This role works alongside senior program managers and cross\-functional partners to turn physical security innovation into reality across the Amazon network.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of program or project management experience
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Bachelor's degree in relevant field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Role overview**
We are looking for an experienced **Service Delivery Manager – Salesforce Managed Services** to lead the delivery and operational management of 24×7 Salesforce Managed Services engagements across global regions.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing Salesforce production support and managed services, handling global clients across **EMEA, APAC, ANZ, US, and Canada**, and leading distributed teams of **15–20\+ resources**.
The role requires a combination of client management, service delivery, Salesforce functional knowledge, incident and problem management, team leadership, reporting, governance, and ITSM practices.  

  

**Key responsibilities:**
**1\.Service Delivery \& Managed Services**

* Manage daily operations across incidents, service requests, problems, changes, and escalations.
* Ensure appropriate shift coverage and seamless handover across global time zones.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve service quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.

**2\.Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key business stakeholders.
* Manage client communication across EMEA, APAC, ANZ, US, and Canada time zones.
* Conduct regular service review meetings and operational governance calls.
* Communicate incidents, risks, escalations, service performance, and corrective actions effectively.
* Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and maintain high levels of client satisfaction.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution with appropriate internal teams.

**3\.Team Management**
* Lead and manage a 15–20 member Salesforce Managed Services team, including administrators, developers, L2/L3 support resources, and functional consultants.
* Manage resource allocation, shift planning, workload distribution, utilization, and capacity planning.
* Mentor team members and drive knowledge development and cross\-skilling.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability within the support organization.
* Conduct regular team reviews and performance discussions.

**4\.Incident Management \& Triage**
* Own the incident management process from identification through resolution and closure.
* Triage incoming incidents and service requests based on business impact, severity, priority, and SLA.
* Analyze issues at a basic Salesforce functional and technical level and provide initial troubleshooting or resolution wherever possible.
* Ensure appropriate issues are efficiently escalated to L2/L3 teams when deeper technical expertise is required.
* Coordinate major incident management and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure proper RCA, corrective action, and preventive action for recurring or critical incidents.

**5\.Salesforce Knowledge**

* Apply good knowledge of Salesforce administration, case management, users, security, configuration, workflows, automation, and integrations.

* Maintain working knowledge of Salesforce environments, releases, deployments, and production support processes.
* Communicate effectively with Salesforce Administrators, Developers, Architects, and business stakeholders.

**6\.ITSM \& Operational Processes**
* Apply strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM principles and service management processes.
* Manage Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, Knowledge Management, Major Incident Management, and SLA Management processes.
* Work with Jira and ITSM/service management tools such as ServiceNow or similar platforms.
* Ensure operational processes, workflows, escalation matrices, and support procedures are properly documented.

**7\.Reporting \& Governance**
* Prepare and present regular service delivery reports and dashboards.
* Track and report SLA compliance, incident volume, MTTR, first response time, backlog, aging tickets, reopened tickets, escalations, CSAT, productivity, utilization, and change success rate.
* Create data\-driven insights and identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Present operational performance to client stakeholders and leadership.

**8\.Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Ensure excellent documentation of operational processes, SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, KT documents, and support procedures.

e707633a.title: AI Architect
e707633a.description:
Qualification:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative **AI Architect** to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.


You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost\-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.


It is deliberately a **hands\-on architect** role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.


Skills Required:
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI


Role:
### **Shape demand and executive conviction**


* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.

Identify pain points, value levers, and high\-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins* platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target\-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

### **Own the architecture**


* Own end\-to\-end architecture: LLM and model\-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non\-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build\-vs\-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine\-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

### **Prove it**


* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red\-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase\-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

### **Win and hand over**


* Author and quality\-gate client\-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep\-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

### **Build the practice**


* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next\-generation AI\-led experiences and co\-funded initiatives.

**Must\-have skills and experience**
------------------------------------


**Architecture and platform depth**


* Proven track record architecting and shipping production\-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade\-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine\-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event\-driven and API\-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi\-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first\-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands\-on)**


* Hands\-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi\-agent and long\-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human\-in\-the\-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge\-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands\-on)**


* Hands\-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third\-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands\-on Docker\-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — **mandatory**.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model provider and hyperscaler GenAI platform know\-how**


* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier\-model providers and hyperscalers, with **deep, hands\-on mastery of at least one** — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:
	+ **Anthropic** — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
	+ **OpenAI** — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine\-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data\-handling commitments.
	+ **AWS** — Amazon Bedrock (multi\-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
	+ **Google** — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
	+ **Microsoft Azure** — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure\-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.
* Able to construct and defend a **multi\-provider model strategy**: capability\-to\-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context\-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version\-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training\-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider\-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over\-abstracting to the point of losing provider\-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast\-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production\-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**


* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands\-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM\-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

**Good to have**
----------------


* Prior experience in a pre\-sales, consulting, solution\-architecture, or forward\-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner\-funded or co\-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early\-access participation, and joint go\-to\-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self\-hosted / open\-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on\-prem GPU) for clients with strict data\-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open\-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.
